name: Power Word: Shield
description: Shields an ally for 15 sec, absorbing 1,747 damage.

name: Backstab
description: Stab the target, causing 38 Physical damage. Damage increased by 20% when you are behind your target.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Invisibility
description: Turns you invisible over 3 sec, reducing threat each second. While invisible, you are untargetable by enemies. Lasts 20 sec. Taking any action cancels the effect.

name: Incapacitating Roar
description: Shift into Bear Form and invoke the spirit of Ursol to let loose a deafening roar, incapacitating all enemies within 10 yards for 3 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

name: Charge
description: Charge to an enemy, dealing 7 Physical damage, rooting it for 1 sec.\n\nGenerates 20 Rage.

name: Frostbolt
description: Launches a bolt of frost at the enemy, causing 1,008 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50% for 8 sec.

name: Polymorph
description: Transforms the enemy into a sheep, wandering around incapacitated for 1 min. While affected, the victim cannot take actions but will regenerate health very quickly. Damage may cancel the effect. Limit 1.\n\nOnly works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.

name: Cone of Cold
description: Targets in a cone in front of you take 174 Frost damage and have movement slowed by 50% for 8 sec.

name: Frost Nova
description: Blasts enemies within 12 yds of you for 20 Frost damage and freezes them in place for 6 sec. Damage may interrupt the freeze effect.

name: Eye of Kilrogg
description: Summons an Eye of Kilrogg and binds your vision to it. The eye is stealthed and moves quickly but is very fragile.

name: Slow Fall
description: Slows a group member's falling speed for 30 sec.

name: Fireball
description: Throws a fiery ball that causes 1,616 Fire damage.

name: Mend Pet
description: Heals your pet for 50% of its total health over 10 sec.

name: Entangling Roots
description: Roots the target in place for 30 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

name: Immolate
description: Burns the enemy, causing 354 Fire damage immediately and an additional 1,493 Fire damage over 18 sec.\n\nPeriodic damage generates 1 Soul Shard Fragment and has a 50% chance to generate an additional 1 on critical strikes.

name: Taunt
description: Taunts the target to attack you, and increases the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.

name: Purge
description: Purges the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial Magic effect.

name: Kidney Shot
description:
Finishing move that stuns the target. Lasts longer per combo point, up to 8 sec:
   1 point : 4 seconds
   2 points: 5 seconds
   3 points: 6 seconds
   4 points: 7 seconds
   5 points: 8 seconds

name: Mind Soothe
description: Soothes enemies in the target area, reducing the range at which they will detect you by 10 yards. Only affects Humanoid and Dragonkin targets. Does not cause threat. Lasts 20 sec.

name: Devotion Aura
description: Party and raid members within 40 yds are bolstered by their devotion, reducing damage taken by 3%.

name: Remove Curse
description: Removes all Curses from a friendly target.

name: Divine Protection
description: Reduces all damage you take by 20% for 8 sec. Usable while stunned.

name: Purify
description: Dispels harmful effects on the target, removing all Magic effects.

name: Dispel Magic
description: Dispels Magic on the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial Magic effect.

name: Water Walking
description: Allows the friendly target to walk across water for 10 min. Damage will cancel the effect.

name: Astral Recall
description: Yanks you through the twisting nether back to your inn. Speak to an Innkeeper in a different place to change your home location.

name: Smite
description: Smites an enemy for 372 Holy damage.

name: Fade
description: Fade out, removing all your threat and reducing enemies' detection range against you for 10 sec.

name: Shadow Word: Pain
description: A word of darkness that causes 64 Shadow damage instantly, and an additional 424 Shadow damage over 16 sec.

name: Prayer of Healing
description: A powerful prayer that heals your target and 4 injured allies within 40 yards for 2,230.

name: Mind Control
description: Controls a mind up to 1 level above yours for 30 sec. Does not work versus Demonic, Undead, or Mechanical beings. Shares diminishing returns with other disorienting effects.

name: Lay on Hands
description: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to 100% your maximum health.\n\nCannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

name: Divine Shield
description: Grants immunity to all damage, harmful effects, knockbacks and forced movement effects for 8 sec. \n\nCannot be used if you have Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

name: Shadow Bolt
description: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 651 Shadow damage.

name: Summon Imp
description: Summons an Imp under your command that casts ranged Firebolts.

name: Summon Felhunter
description: Summons a Felhunter under your command, able to disrupt the spell casts of your enemies.

name: Summon Voidwalker
description: Summons a Voidwalker under your command, able to withstand heavy punishment.

name: Ritual of Summoning
description: Begins a ritual to create a summoning portal, requiring the caster and 2 allies to complete. This portal can be used to summon party and raid members.

name: Curse of Weakness
description: Increases the time between an enemy's attacks by 20% for 2 min.\n\nCurses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.

name: Garrote
description: Garrote the enemy, causing 159 Bleed damage over 18 sec.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Banish
description: Banishes an enemy Demon, Aberration, or Elemental, preventing any action for 30 sec. Limit 1. Casting Banish again on the target will cancel the effect.

name: Tranquility
description: Heals all allies within 40 yards for 19,417 over 5.4 sec.\n\nHealing decreased beyond 5 targets.

name: Cat Form
description: Shapeshift into Cat Form, increasing auto-attack damage by 40%, movement speed by 30%, granting protection from Polymorph effects, and reducing falling damage.\n\nThe act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.

name: Rend
description: Lash out with your weapon, striking all targets within 10 yds for 92 Physical damage instantly and wounding them for an additional 74 Bleed damage over 15 sec.

name: Rejuvenation
description: Heals the target for 1,672 over 12 sec.

name: Disengage
description: Leap backwards.

name: Travel Form
description: Shapeshift into a travel form appropriate to your current location, increasing movement speed on land, in water, or in the air, and granting protection from Polymorph effects.\n\nThe act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.

name: Cleave
description: Strikes all enemies in front of you for 90 Physical damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

name: Hammer of Justice
description: Stuns the target for 6 sec.

name: Shield Wall
description: Reduces all damage you take by 40% for 8 sec.

name: Call Pet 1
description: Summons your first pet to you.

name: Pick Pocket
description: Pick the target's pocket.

name: Earth Shield
description: Protects the target with an earthen shield, increasing your healing on them by 20% and healing them for 332 when they take damage. This heal can only occur once every 3 sec. Maximum 9 charges.\n\nEarth Shield can only be placed on one target at a time. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman.

name: Agony
description: Inflicts increasing agony on the target, causing up to 2,379 Shadow damage over 18 sec. Damage starts low and increases over the duration. Refreshing Agony maintains its current damage level.\n\nAgony damage sometimes generates 1 Soul Shard.

name: Revive Pet
description: Revives your pet, returning it to life with 100% of its base health.

name: Blessing of Protection
description: Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to Physical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec.\n\nCannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

name: Blessing of Freedom
description: Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 8 sec.

name: Chain Heal
description: Heals the friendly target for 875, then jumps up to 20 yards to heal the 3 most injured nearby allies. Healing is reduced by 30% with each jump.

name: Rip
description:
Finishing move that causes Bleed damage over time. Lasts longer per combo point.

   1 point  : 8 over 1 sec
   2 points: 12 over 2 sec
   3 points: 16 over 3 sec
   4 points: 20 over 3 sec
   5 points: 24 over 4 sec

name: Subjugate Demon
description: Subjugates the target demon up to level 71, forcing it to do your bidding for 10 min.

name: Summon Infernal
description: Summons an Infernal from the Twisting Nether, impacting for 231 Fire damage and stunning all enemies in the area for 2 sec.\n\nThe Infernal will serve you for 30 sec, dealing 211 damage to all nearby enemies every 1.8 sec and generating 1 Soul Shard Fragment every 1 sec.

name: Mark of the Wild
description: Infuse a friendly target with the power of the wild, increasing their Versatility by 3% for 60 minutes.\n\nIf target is in your party or raid, all party and raid members will be affected.

name: Demoralizing Shout
description: Demoralizes all enemies within 10 yards, reducing the damage they deal to you by 20% for 8 sec.

name: Challenging Shout
description: Taunts all enemies within 10 yds to attack you for 6 sec, and increases the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.

name: Arcane Explosion
description: Causes an explosion of magic around the caster, dealing 250 Arcane damage to all enemies within 10 yards.\n\nGenerates 1 Arcane Charge if any targets are hit.

name: Arcane Intellect
description: Infuses the target with brilliance, increasing their Intellect by 3% for 1 hour.  \n\nIf the target is in your party or raid, all party and raid members will be affected.

name: Beast Lore
description: Gathers information about the target beast, displaying diet, abilities, specialization, whether or not the creature is tameable, and if it is exotic.

name: Slam
description: Slams an opponent, causing 106 Physical damage.

name: Track Beasts
description: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap.

name: Scare Beast
description: Scares a beast, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect.  Only one beast can be feared at a time.

name: Tame Beast
description: Tames a beast to be your companion. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail.\n\nYou must dismiss any active beast companions and have an empty Call Pet slot before you can begin taming a new beast. Only Beast Mastery specialized Hunters can tame Exotic Beasts.

name: Flare
description: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within the targeted area for 20 sec.

name: Whirlwind
description: Unleashes a whirlwind of steel, striking all nearby targets for 74 Physical damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

name: Levitate
description: Levitates a party or raid member for 10 min, floating a few feet above the ground, granting slow fall, and allowing travel over water.

name: Curse of Tongues
description: Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 30% for 1 min.\n\nCurses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.

name: Hamstring
description: Maims the enemy for 5 Physical damage, reducing movement speed by 50% for 15 sec.

name: Recklessness
description: Go berserk, increasing all Rage generation by 50% and granting your abilities 20% increased critical strike chance for 12 sec.

name: Distract
description: Throws a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby monsters for 10 seconds. Usable while stealthed.

name: Sinister Strike
description: Viciously strike an enemy, causing 31 Physical damage.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Kick
description: A quick kick that interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec.

name: Gouge
description:
Gouges the eyes of an enemy target, incapacitating for 4 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect.

Must be in front of your target.

Awards 1 combo point.

name: Stealth
description: Conceals you in the shadows until cancelled, allowing you to stalk enemies without being seen.

name: Pick Lock
description: Allows opening of locked chests and doors that require a skill level of up to 70.

name: Rake
description: Rake the target for 10 Bleed damage and an additional 57 Bleed damage over 15 sec.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Cheap Shot
description: Stuns the target for 6 sec.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Dash
description: Shift into Cat Form and increase your movement speed by 60% while in Cat Form for 10 sec.

name: Vanish
description: Allows you to vanish from sight, entering stealth while in combat. For the first 3 sec after vanishing, damage and harmful effects received will not break stealth. Also breaks movement impairing effects.

name: Rupture
description:
Finishing move that tears open the target, dealing Bleed damage over time. Lasts longer per combo point.

   1 point  : 9 over 8 sec
   2 points: 13 over 12 sec
   3 points: 18 over 16 sec
   4 points: 22 over 20 sec
   5 points: 26 over 24 sec

name: Blink
description: Teleports you forward 20 yds or until reaching an obstacle, and frees you from all stuns and bonds.

name: Feint
description: Performs an evasive maneuver, reducing damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by 40% for 6 sec.

name: Resurrection
description: Brings a dead ally back to life with 35% health and mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Ancestral Spirit
description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 35% of maximum health and mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Holy Word: Serenity
description: Perform a miracle, healing an ally for 8,253.\n\nCooldown reduced by 6 sec when you cast Flash Heal.

name: Flash Heal
description: A fast spell that heals an ally for 2,573.

name: Blind
description: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for 1 min. Damage may interrupt the effect. Limit 1.

name: Mind Vision
description: Allows the caster to see through the target's eyes for 1 min. Will not work if the target is in another instance or on another continent.

name: Dispatch
description:
Finishing move that dispatches the enemy, dealing damage per combo point:
   1 point  : 21 damage
   2 points: 44 damage
   3 points: 65 damage
   4 points: 85 damage
   5 points: 109 damage

name: Flamestrike
description: Calls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for 1,220 Fire damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.\n\nThis spell is cast at a selected location.

name: Counterspell
description: Counters the enemy's spellcast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 7 sec.

name: Earthbind Totem
description: Summons a totem at the target location for 20 sec that slows the movement speed of enemies within 10 yards by 50%.

name: Shield Block
description: Raise your shield, blocking all melee attacks against you for 6 sec.

name: Hibernate
description: Forces the enemy target to sleep for up to 40 sec. Any damage will awaken the target. Only one target can be forced to hibernate at a time. Only works on Beasts and Dragonkin.

name: Dismiss Pet
description: Temporarily sends this pet away. You can call it back later.

name: Ghost Wolf
description: Turn into a Ghost Wolf, increasing movement speed by 30% and preventing movement speed from being reduced below 100%.

name: Growl
description: Your pet growls at the target, generating threat, taunting the target to attack the pet.

name: Remove Corruption
description: Nullifies corrupting effects on the friendly target, removing all Curse and Poison effects.

name: Denounce
description: Casts down the enemy with a bolt of Holy Light, causing 2,899 Holy damage and preventing the target from causing critical effects for the next 8 sec.

name: Deadly Poison
description: Coats your weapons with a Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance to poison the enemy for 27 Nature damage over 12 sec. Subsequent poison applications will instantly deal 2 Nature damage.

name: Deadly Poison
description: Coats your weapons with a Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance to poison the enemy for 27 Nature damage over 12 sec. Subsequent poison applications will instantly deal 2 Nature damage.

name: Bloodlust
description: Increases haste by 30% for all party and raid members for 40 sec.\n\nAllies receiving this effect will become Sated and unable to benefit from Bloodlust or Time Warp again for 10 min.

name: Soothe
description: Soothes the target, dispelling all enrage effects.

name: Scorch
description:
Scorches an enemy for 410 Fire damage.

When cast on a target below 30% health, Scorch is a guaranteed critical strike.

Castable while moving.

name: Sprint
description: Increases your movement speed by 70% for 8 sec. Usable while stealthed.

name: Crippling Poison
description: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance to poison the enemy, slowing movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.

name: Intervene
description: Run at high speed toward an ally, intercepting all melee and ranged attacks against them for 6 sec while they remain within 10 yds.

name: Teleport: Stormwind
description: Teleports you to Stormwind.

name: Teleport: Ironforge
description: Teleports you to Ironforge.

name: Teleport: Undercity
description: Teleports you to Undercity.

name: Teleport: Darnassus
description: Teleports you to Darnassus.

name: Teleport: Thunder Bluff
description: Teleports you to Thunder Bluff.

name: Teleport: Orgrimmar
description: Teleports you to Orgrimmar.

name: Path of Frost
description: Activates a freezing aura for 10 min that creates ice beneath your feet, allowing party or raid members within 50 yards to walk on water.\n\nUsable while mounted, but being attacked or damaged will cancel the effect.

name: Cleanse
description: Cleanses a friendly target, removing all Magic effects.

name: Concussive Shot
description: Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

name: Arcane Missiles
description: Requires Clearcasting\nLaunches 5 waves of Arcane Missiles at the enemy over 2.2 sec, causing a total of 2,162 Arcane damage.

name: Wrath
description: Hurl a ball of energy at the target, dealing 229 Nature damage.

name: Mighty Bash
description: Invokes the spirit of Ursoc to stun the target for 4 sec. Usable in all shapeshift forms.

name: Tiger's Fury
description: Instantly restores 50 Energy, and increases the damage of all your attacks by 15% for their full duration. Lasts 10 sec.

name: Shred
description: Shred the target, causing 75 Physical damage to the target.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Track Humanoids
description: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap.

name: Intimidating Shout
description: Causes the targeted enemy to cower in fear while all enemies within 8 yards flee from you and their movement speed is reduced by 70% for 8 sec.\nDamage may cancel the effect.

name: Evasion
description: Increases your dodge chance by 100% for 10 sec.

name: Mutilate
description: Instantly attacks for 41 Physical damage.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Feign Death
description: Feign death, tricking enemies into ignoring you. Lasts up to 6 min.

name: Healing Stream Totem
description: Summons a totem at your feet for 15 sec that heals an injured party or raid member within 40 yards for 254 every 1.8 sec.\n\nIf you already know Healing Stream Totem, instead gain 1 additional charge of Healing Stream Totem.

name: Howl of Terror
description: Let loose a terrifying howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in fear, disorienting them for 20 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

name: Bear Form
description: Shapeshift into Bear Form, increasing armor by 220% and Stamina by 25%, granting protection from Polymorph effects, and increasing threat generation.\n\nThe act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.

name: Sense Undead
description: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap until cancelled. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

name: Unending Breath
description: Allows an ally to breathe underwater and increases swim speed by 20% for 10 min.

name: Rain of Fire
description: Calls down a rain of hellfire the target location, dealing 1,395 Fire damage over 7.1 sec to enemies in the area.\n\nThis spell is cast at a selected location.

name: Numbing Poison
description: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, clouding their mind and slowing their attack and casting speed by 15% for 10 sec.

name: Fear
description: Strikes fear in the enemy, disorienting for 20 sec. Damage may cancel the effect. Limit 1.

name: Felsteed
description: Summons a Felsteed, which serves as a mount.

name: Shiv
description: Attack with your off-hand, dealing 2 Physical damage, dispelling all enrage effects and applying a concentrated form of your active Non-Lethal poison.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Far Sight
description: Changes your viewpoint to the targeted location for 1 min.

name: Eagle Eye
description: Changes your viewpoint to the targeted location for 1 min. Only usable outdoors.

name: Create Healthstone
description: Creates a Healthstone that can be consumed to restore 25% health.

name: Thunder Clap
description: Blasts all enemies within 8 yards for 82 Physical damage and reduces their movement speed by 20% for 10 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.\n\nIf you know Rend, inflicts Rend on all targets.

name: Soul Fire
description: Burns the enemy's soul, dealing 10,170 Fire damage and applying Immolate.\n\nGenerates 1 Soul Shard.

name: Heroic Leap
description: Leap through the air toward a target location, slamming down with destructive force to deal 8 Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yards.

name: Pummel
description: Pummels the target, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

name: Revenge
description: Swing in a wide arc, dealing 84 Physical damage to all enemies in front of you. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.\n\nYour successful dodges and parries have a chance to make your next Revenge cost no Rage.

name: Battle Shout
description: Increases the attack power of all raid and party members within 100 yards by 5% for 1 hour.

name: Sap
description: Incapacitates a target not in combat for 1 min. Only works on Humanoids, Beasts, Demons, and Dragonkin. Damage will revive the target. Limit 1.

name: Mortal Coil
description: Horrifies an enemy target into fleeing, incapacitating for 3 sec and healing you for 20% of maximum health.

name: Growl
description: Taunts the target to attack you, and increases the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.

name: Maul
description: Maul the target for 76 Physical damage.

name: Blessing of Sacrifice
description: Blesses a party or raid member, reducing their damage taken by 30%, but you suffer 100% of damage prevented.\n\nLast 12 sec, or until transferred damage would cause you to fall below 20% health.

name: Feed Pet
description: Feeds your pet the selected item, instantly restoring 50% of its total health. Not usable in combat.\n\nYou may use the Beast Lore ability to identify what types of foods your pet will eat.

name: Redemption
description: Brings a dead ally back to life with 35% of maximum health and mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Overpower
description: Overpower the enemy, dealing 132 Physical damage. Cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

name: Healing Surge
description: A quick surge of healing energy that restores 4,164 of a friendly target's health.

name: Earth Shock
description: Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 3,011 Nature damage.

name: Mind Blast
description: Blast the target's mind for 301 Shadow damage. Costs a high amount of mana.

name: Psychic Scream
description: Lets out a psychic scream, causing all enemies within 8 yards to flee, disorienting them for 8 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect.

name: Tremor Totem
description: Summons a totem at your feet that shakes the ground around it for 10 sec, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party and raid members within 30 yards.

name: Ambush
description: Ambush the target, causing 96 Physical damage.\n\nAwards 2 combo points.

name: Wound Poison
description: Coats your weapons with a Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance to poison the enemy, which instantly inflicts 1 Nature damage and reduces all healing received by 8% for 12 sec, stacking up to 3 times.

name: Moonfire
description: A quick beam of lunar light burns the enemy for 80 Arcane damage and then an additional 705 Arcane damage over 18 sec.

name: Regrowth
description: Heals a friendly target for 1,996 and another 287 over 6 sec.

name: Shackle Horror
description: Shackles an aberration or undead enemy for 50 sec, preventing all actions and movement. Damage will cancel the effect. Limit 1.

name: Portal: Stormwind
description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Stormwind.

name: Power Infusion
description: Infuses the target with power for 15 sec, increasing haste by 20%.\n\nCan only be cast on players.

name: Turn Evil
description: The power of the Light compels an Undead, Aberration, or Demon target to flee for up to 40 sec. Damage may break the effect. Lesser creatures have a chance to be destroyed. Only one target can be turned at a time.

name: Flametongue Attack
description: Imbue your weapon with the element of Fire for 1 hour, increasing the damage of your Fire spells by 5.0%.

name: Pyroblast
description: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 2,465 Fire damage.

name: Portal: Ironforge
description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Ironforge.

name: Portal: Orgrimmar
description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Orgrimmar.

name: Portal: Undercity
description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Undercity.

name: Portal: Darnassus
description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Darnassus.

name: Portal: Thunder Bluff
description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Thunder Bluff.

name: Ice Barrier
description: Shields you with ice, absorbing 9,165 damage for 1 min.\n\nMelee attacks against you reduce the attacker's movement speed by 50%.

name: Evocation
description: Increases your mana regeneration by 1,500% for 2.7 sec.

name: Mortal Strike
description: A vicious strike that deals 183 Physical damage and reduces the effectiveness of healing on the target by 50% for 10 sec.

name: Piercing Howl
description: Snares all enemies within 12 yards, reducing their movement speed by 70% for 8 sec.\n\nSpurs all allies within 6 yards, increasing their movement speed by 30% for 4 sec.

name: Mastery: Ignite
description: Your target burns for an additional 9.9% over 9 sec of the total direct damage caused by your Fireball, Fire Blast,  Pyroblast, and Flamestrike. If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Ignite.

name: Improved Whirlwind
description:
Whirlwind causes your next 4 single-target attacks to strike up to 4 additional targets for 65% damage.

Whirlwind generates 3 Rage plus an additional 1 per target hit. Maximum 8 Rage.

If you know Rend, Whirlwind inflicts Rend on all targets.

name: Adrenaline Rush
description: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 75%, your maximum Energy by 50, and your attack speed by 20% for 15 sec.

name: Summon Warhorse
description: Summons a Warhorse, which serves as a mount.

name: Ruthlessness
description: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point spent to grant a combo point.

name: Seal Fate
description: Critical strikes with attacks that generate combo points grant an additional combo point per critical strike.

name: Holy Fire
description: Consumes the enemy in Holy flames that cause 1,184 Holy damage and an additional 421 Holy damage over 7 sec.

name: Vigor
description: Increases your maximum Energy by 50 and Energy regeneration by 5%.

name: Vampiric Embrace
description: Fills you with the embrace of Shadow energy for 12 sec, causing you to heal a nearby ally for 40% of any single-target Shadow spell damage you deal.

name: Mind Flay
description: Assaults the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 2,740 Shadow damage over 4.0 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.\n\nGenerates 18 Insanity over the duration.

name: Silence
description: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec. Against non-players, also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.

name: Master of the Elements
description: Casting Lava Burst increases the damage or healing of your next Nature, Physical, or Frost spell by 15%.

name: Resurgence
description: Your direct heal criticals refund a percentage of your maximum mana: 0.80% from Healing Wave, 0.48% from Riptide, and 0.20% from Chain Heal.

name: Omen of Clarity
description: Your auto attacks have a chance to cause a Clearcasting state, making your next Shred or Swipe cost no Energy.

name: Clearcasting
description: Your healing over time from Lifebloom has a 4% chance to cause a Clearcasting state, making your next Regrowth cost no mana.

name: Thick Hide
description: Reduces all damage taken by 4%.

name: Predatory Swiftness
description: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to make your next Regrowth or Entangling Roots instant, free, and castable in all forms.

name: Shadowburn
description: Blasts a target for 1,907 Shadowflame damage. Only usable on enemies that have less than 20% health.\n\nRestores 1 Soul Shard and refunds a charge if the target dies within 5 sec.

name: Conflagrate
description: Triggers an explosion on the target, dealing 1,358 Fire damage.\n\nGenerates 5 Soul Shard Fragments.

name: Berserker Rage
description: Go berserk, removing and granting immunity to Fear, Sap, and some Incapacitate effects for 6 sec.

name: Swiftmend
description: Consume a Regrowth, Wild Growth, or Rejuvenation effect to instantly heal an ally for 3,860.

name: Teleport: Moonglade
description: Teleport to the Moonglade.\n\nCasting Teleport: Moonglade while in Moonglade will return you back to near your departure point.

name: Desperate Prayer
description: Increases maximum health by 25% for 10 sec, and instantly heals you for that amount.

name: Aimed Shot
description: A powerful aimed shot that deals 283 Physical damage.

name: Bestial Wrath

description: Gain 30 Energy over 3 sec when you enter Stealth or activate Shadow Dance.

name: Light of the Naaru
description: The cooldowns of your Holy Words are reduced by an additional 10% when you cast the relevant spells.

name: Maneuverability
description: Sprint has 50% reduced cooldown and 50% reduced duration.

name: Shield Discipline
description: When your Power Word: Shield is completely absorbed, you restore 0.5% of your maximum mana.

name: Stonebark
description: Ironbark increases healing from your heal over time effects by 20%.

name: Inner Peace
description: Reduces the cooldown of Tranquility by 30 sec.\n\nWhile channeling Tranquility, you take 20% reduced damage and are immune to knockbacks.

name: Sundering
description: Shatters a line of earth in front of you with your main hand weapon, causing 89 Flamestrike damage to any enemy hit.

name: Beacon of the Lightbringer
description: Mastery: Lightbringer now increases your healing based on the target's proximity to either you or your Beacon of Light, whichever is closer.

name: Astral Influence
description: Increases the range of all of your spells by 5 yards.

name: Strength of Soul
description: Your Power Word: Shield reduces all Physical damage taken by 15% while the shield persists.

name: Starsurge
description: Launch a surge of stellar energies at the target, dealing 796 Astral damage.

name: Starfire
description: Call down a burst of energy, causing 360 Arcane damage to the target, and 126 Arcane damage to all other enemies within 5 yards. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Flourish
description: Tranquility extends the duration of all of your heal over time effects by 2 sec every 0.9 sec.

name: Shuriken Storm
description: Sprays shurikens at all enemies within 10 yards, dealing 22 Physical damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.\n\nAwards 1 combo point per target hit.

name: Archangel
description: Evangelism increases your healing and absorption effects by 15% for 18 sec.

name: Focused Thunder
description: Thunder Focus Tea now empowers your next 2 spells.

name: Silhouette
description: Shadowstep's cooldown is reduced by 67% when cast on a friendly target.

name: Mist Wrap
description: Increases Enveloping Mist's duration by 1 sec and its healing bonus by 10%.

name: Lifecycles
description: Vivify has a 20% chance to cause your next Rising Sun Kick or Enveloping Mist to generate 1 stack of Mana Tea.\n\nEnveloping Mist and Rising Sun Kick have a 20% chance to cause your next Vivify to generate 1 stack of Mana Tea.

name: Eye Beam
description: Blasts all enemies in front of you, for up to 281 Chaos damage over 1.8 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

name: Turn the Tables
description: After coming out of a stun, you deal 10% increased damage for 12 sec.

name: Power of the Dark Side
description: Shadow Word: Pain has a chance to empower your next Penance with Shadow, increasing its effectiveness by 30%.

name: Kleptomania
description: Unleash a flurry of disruptive magic onto your target, stealing a beneficial magic effect every 0.4 sec for 3.6 sec.\n\nCastable while moving, but movement speed is reduced by 40% while channeling.

name: Earth Elemental
description: Calls forth a Greater Earth Elemental to protect you and your allies, generating high threat and taunting enemies periodically for 30 sec.

name: System Shock
description: Casting Envenom with at least 5 combo points on a target afflicted by your Garrote, Rupture, and lethal poison deals 11 Nature damage, and reduces their movement speed by 90% for 2 sec.

name: Concentrated Coolness
description: Frozen Orb's damage is increased by 10% and is now castable at a location with a 40 yard range but no longer moves.

name: Blur
description: Reduces all damage taken by 25% for 10 sec.

name: Dagger in the Dark
description: Each second while Stealth is active, nearby enemies within 12 yards take an additional 2% damage from you for 10 sec. Stacks up to 6 times.

name: Vengeful Retreat
description: Remove all snares and vault away. Nearby enemies take 5 Physical damage.

name: Song of Chi-Ji
description: Conjures a cloud of hypnotic mist that slowly travels forward. Enemies touched by the mist fall asleep, Disoriented for 20 sec.

name: Shield Bash
description: When Shield Slam is used on targets that are casting, it reduces their damage done by 15% for 8 sec and the cooldown is instantly reset.

name: Morale Killer
description: Reduces the cooldown of Demoralizing Shout by 15 sec, and Demoralizing Shout now reduces the damage enemies deal to all targets, not just you.

name: Thunderstruck
description: After casting Avatar, Shockwave, or Stormbolt, your next Thunder Clap roots all targets it damages for 4 sec.

name: Driven to Madness
description: While Voidform is not active, being attacked will reduce the cooldown of Voidform by 3 sec.

name: Death Wish
description: Increases your damage taken and done by 10% for 15 sec at the cost of 10% of your health. Stacks up to 5 times.

name: Divine Vision
description: Increases the range of your Aura by 30 yards and reduces the cooldown of Aura Mastery by 30 sec.

name: Cleanse the Weak
description: When you Cleanse an ally, 1 ally within 40 yds is dispelled of the same effects, but the cooldown of Cleanse is increased by 4 sec.\n\nHealing allies with your Flash of Light or Holy Light will cleanse all Diseases and Poisons from the target.

name: Holy Ritual
description: Allies are healed for 7,552 when you cast Blessing of Protection or Blessing of Sacrifice on them.

name: Mind Trauma
description: Siphon haste from enemies, stealing 2% haste per stack of Mind Trauma, stacking up to 9 times. Fully channeled Mind Flays grant 1 stack of Mind Trauma and fully channeled Void Torrents grant 3 stacks of Mind Trauma. Lasts 15 sec.\n\nYou can only gain 3 stacks of Mind Trauma from a single enemy.

name: Ultimate Sacrifice
description: Your Blessing of Sacrifice now transfers 100% of all damage to you into a damage over time effect, but lasts 6 sec and no longer cancels when you are below 20% health.

name: Spreading the Word
description:
Your allies affected by your Aura gain an effect after you cast Blessing of Protection or Blessing of Freedom.

 Blessing of Protection
Physical damage reduced by 30% for 6 sec.

 Blessing of Freedom
Cleared of all movement impairing effects.

name: Camouflage
description: You and your pet blend into the surroundings and gain stealth for 1 min. While camouflaged, you will heal for 2% of maximum health every 1 sec.

name: Psychic Link
description: Your direct damage spells inflict 25% of their damage on all other targets afflicted by your Vampiric Touch within 40 yards.\n\nDoes not apply to damage from Shadowy Apparitions, Shadow Word: Pain, and Vampiric Touch.

name: Stomp
description: When you cast Barbed Shot, your pet stomps the ground, dealing 50 Physical damage to all nearby enemies.

name: Killer Cobra
description: While Bestial Wrath is active, Cobra Shot resets the cooldown on Kill Command.

name: Steed of Glory
description: Your Divine Steed lasts for an additional 2 sec.\n\nWhile active you become immune to movement impairing effects, and you knock back enemies that you move through.

name: Shroud of Winter
description: Enemies within 8 yards of you become shrouded in winter, reducing the range of their spells and abilities by 30%.

name: Decomposing Aura
description: All enemies within 8 yards slowly decay, losing up to 3% of their max health every 2 sec. Max 5 stacks. Lasts 6 sec.

name: Find Treasure
description: You can sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap. Lasts until canceled.

name: Trailblazer
description: Your movement speed is increased by 30% anytime you have not attacked for 3 sec.

name: Beacon of Virtue
description: Apply a Beacon of Light to your target and 4 injured allies within 30 yds for 9 sec.\n\nAll affected allies will be healed for 10% of the amount of your other healing done.

name: Torrent
description: Riptide's initial heal is increased 20% and has a 10% increased critical strike chance.

name: Deluge
description: Healing Wave and Chain Heal heal for an additional 15% on targets affected by your Healing Rain or Riptide.

name: Trail of Light
description: 25% of healing done by Flash Heal is replicated to the previous target you healed with those spells.

name: Apotheosis
description: Reset the cooldown of your Holy Words, and enter a pure Holy form for 20 sec, increasing the cooldown reductions to your Holy Words by 200% and reducing their cost by 50%.

name: Censure
description: Holy Word: Chastise stuns the target for 4 sec and is not broken by damage.

name: Guardian Angel
description: When Guardian Spirit saves the target from death, it does not expire.\n\nWhen Guardian Spirit expires without saving the target from death, reduce its remaining cooldown to 60 seconds.

name: Prosperity
description: Swiftmend now has 2 charges.

name: Cultivation
description: When Rejuvenation heals a target below 60% health, they are instantly healed for 115.

name: Protection of Tyr
description: Aura Mastery also increases all healing received by party or raid members within 40 yards by 10%.

name: Crescent Burn
description: Using Moonfire on a target already afflicted by Moonfire's damage over time effect deals 35% additional direct damage.

name: Fel Fissure
description: Chaos Bolt creates a 5 yd wide eruption of Felfire under the target, reducing movement speed by 50% and reducing all healing received by 25% on all enemies within the fissure. Lasts 6 sec.

name: Tyr's Deliverance
description: Releases the Light within yourself, healing 5 injured allies instantly and an injured ally every 0.9 sec within 40 yds for 133.\n\nAllies healed also receive 10% increased healing from your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells for 12 sec.

name: Airborne Irritant
description: Blind has 50% reduced cooldown, 70% reduced duration, and applies to all nearby enemies.

name: Gloomblade
description: Punctures your target with your shadow-infused blade for 43 Shadow damage, bypassing armor.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Plea
description: A quick, efficient plea to heal an ally for 1,140.

name: Gory Fur
description: Mangle has a 15% chance to reduce the Rage cost of your next Ironfur by 25%.

name: High Winds
description: Increases the range of Cyclone, Typhoon, and Entangling Roots by 5 yds.

name: Ride the Wind
description: Flying Serpent Kick clears all snares from you when used and forms a path of wind in its wake, causing all allies who stand in it to have 30% increased movement speed and to be immune to movement slowing effects.

name: Fury of the Illidari
description: Throws two demonic glaives in a whirlwind of energy, causing 0 Chaos damage over 3 sec to all nearby enemies.

name: Demoralizing Roar
description: Demoralizes all enemies within 10 yards, reducing the damage they do by 20% for 8 sec.

name: Hot Hand
description: Melee auto-attacks with Flametongue Weapon active have a 5% chance to reduce the cooldown of Lava Lash by 25% and increase the damage of Lava Lash by 20% for 8 sec.\n\nMay not occur during an active Hot Hand.

name: Predator
description: Tiger's Fury lasts 5 additional seconds.\n\nYour combo point-generating abilities' direct damage is increased by 40% of your Haste.

name: Sabertooth
description: Ferocious Bite deals 15% increased damage.\n\nFor each Combo Point spent, Ferocious Bite's primary target takes 6% increased damage from your Cat Form bleed and other periodic abilities for 4 sec.

name: Indomitable
description: Your maximum health is increased by 10% and every 15 Rage you spend heals you for 1% of your maximum health.

name: Microbrew
description: Reduces the cooldown of Fortifying Brew by 50%.

name: Sigil of Silence
description: Place a Sigil of Silence at the target location that activates after 2 sec.\n\nSilences all enemies affected by the sigil for 2 sec.

name: Sigil of Chains
description: Place a Sigil of Chains at the target location that activates after 2 sec.\n\nAll enemies affected by the sigil are pulled to its center and are snared, reducing movement speed by 70% for 6 sec.

name: Avert Harm
description: Guard the 4 closest players within 15 yards for 15 sec, allowing you to Stagger 20% of damage they take.

name: Bounding Stride
description: Reduces the cooldown of Heroic Leap by 15 sec and Heroic Leap also increases your movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.

name: Impending Victory
description: Instantly attack the target, causing 20 damage and healing you for 30% of your maximum health.\n\nKilling an enemy that yields experience or honor resets the cooldown of Impending Victory and makes it cost no Rage.

name: Entangling Claws
description: Entangling Roots is now an instant cast spell with a 6 second cooldown but with a 10 yard range. It can also be cast while in shapeshift forms.

name: Overrun
description: Charge to an enemy, stunning them for 3 sec and knocking back their allies within 15 yards.

name: Fervor of Battle
description: If Cleave or Whirlwind hits 3 or more targets you also Slam your primary target. This Slam deals 50% additional damage.

name: Double Barrel
description: Your next Keg Smash deals 50% additional damage, and stuns all targets it hits for 3 sec.

name: Shooting Stars
description: Moonfire and Sunfire damage over time has a chance to call down a falling star, dealing 258 Astral damage and generating 2 Astral Power.

name: Starlord
description: Starsurge and Starfall grant you 2% Haste for 20 sec or until you enter a new Eclipse.\n\nStacks up to 3 times. Gaining a stack does not refresh the duration.

name: Mighty Ox Kick
description: You perform a Mighty Ox Kick, hurling your enemy a distance behind you.

name: Chrysalis
description: Reduces the cooldown of Life Cocoon by 45 sec.

name: Nature's Balance
description: While in combat you generate 1 Astral Power every 2 sec.\n\nWhile out of combat your Astral Power rebalances to 50 instead of depleting to empty.

name: Best Served Cold
description: Your dodges and parries make your Revenge cost no Rage 20% more frequently and increase the damage your free Revenges deal by 15%. Revenge increases the damage of your next Thunder Clap by 8%.

name: Into the Fray
description: You gain 2% Haste for each enemy or ally within 10 yards, up to 8% Haste.

name: Leader of the Pack
description: While in Cat Form, you increase the movement speed of raid members within 20 yards by 10%.\n\nLeader of the Pack also causes allies to heal themselves for 3% of their maximum health when they critically hit with a direct attack. The healing effect cannot occur more than once every 8 sec.

name: Rot and Wither
description: Your Death and Decay rots enemies each time it deals damage, absorbing healing equal to 100% of damage dealt.

name: Booming Voice
description: Demoralizing Shout also generates 20 Rage and increases damage you deal to affected targets by 20%.

name: Survival Tactics
description: Feign Death reduces damage taken by 90% for 2 sec.

name: Fury of Elune
description: Calls down a beam of pure celestial energy that follows the enemy, dealing up to 1,100 Astral damage over 8 sec within its area. Damage reduced on secondary targets.\n\nGenerates 40 Astral Power over its duration.

name: Light of the Sun
description: Reduces the remaining cooldown on Solar Beam by 15 sec when it interrupts the primary target.

name: Death Chain
description: Chains 3 enemies together, dealing 10.2 Shadow damage and causing 20% of all damage taken to also be received by the others in the chain. Lasts for 10 sec.

name: Heavy Repercussions
description: Shield Slam generates 2 more Rage and extends the duration of Shield Block by 1.0 sec.

name: Crackling Thunder
description: Thunder Clap's radius is increased by 50% and it reduces affected target's movement speed by an additional 20%.

name: Fresh Wound
description: Rake has a 100% increased critical strike chance if used on a target that doesn’t already have Rake active.

name: Hunting Pack
description: Aspect of the Cheetah has 50% reduced cooldown and grants its effects to allies within 15 yds.

name: Wicked Claws
description: Infected Wounds can now stack up to 2 times, and reduces 8% of all healing received by the target per stack.\n\nInfected Wounds can now also be applied from Rip.

name: World in Flames
description: Empower Flamestrike, dealing up to 50% more damage based on enemies' distance to the center of Flamestrike.

name: Greater Pyroblast
description: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that deals up to 30% of the target's total health in Fire damage.

name: Diamond Ice
description: Victims of Freezing Trap can no longer be damaged or healed.  Freezing Trap is now undispellable, but has a 4 sec duration.

name: Fury of the Eagle
description: Furiously strikes all enemies in front of you, dealing 748 Physical damage over 2.7 sec. Critical strike chance increased by 50% against any target below 20% health. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Neltharion's Fury
description: Enter a defensive posture, critically blocking all attacks while a stream of shadowflame erupts from Scale of the Earth-Warder, dealing 40 Shadowflame over 3 sec to all enemies in front of you. You can use defensive abilities while this is active.

name: Blind Fury
description: Eye Beam generates 30 Fury every second, has 10% increased duration, and deals 10% increased damage.

name: Early Spring
description:
Wild Growth is now instant cast, and when you heal 6 allies with Wild Growth you gain Full Bloom. This effect has a 30 sec cooldown.

Full Bloom
Your next Wild Growth applies Lifebloom to all targets at 100% effectiveness. Lasts for 30 sec.

name: Demon Spikes
description: Surge with fel power, increasing your Armor by 75.

name: Brambles
description: Sharp brambles protect you, absorbing and reflecting up to 7 damage from each attack.\n\nWhile Barkskin is active, the brambles also deal 2 Nature damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec.

name: Blood Frenzy
description: Thrash also generates 3 Rage each time it deals damage, on up to 5 targets.

name: Galactic Guardian
description:
Your damage has a 5% chance to trigger a free automatic Moonfire on that target.

 Moonfire:
When this occurs, the next Moonfire you cast generates 8 Rage, and deals 300% increased direct damage.

 Red Moon:
When this occurs, you gain 1 charge of Lunar Wrath. Each 20 Rage you spend while Red Moon is active consumes a stack to deal 380 additional Arcane damage to its target and heal you for 494.

name: Survival of the Fittest
description: Reduces the cooldowns of Barkskin and Survival Instincts by 12%.

name: Soul Fragments
description: Consuming a nearby Soul Fragment heals you.

name: Blessing of Spellwarding
description:
Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to magical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec.

Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

Shares a cooldown with Blessing of Protection.

name: Blessed Hammer
description: Throws a Blessed Hammer that spirals outward, dealing 8 Holy damage to enemies and reducing the next damage they deal to you by 11.\n\nGenerates 1 Holy Power.

name: Fiery Brand
description: Brand yourself and an enemy target with demonic symbols, reducing the damage you take by 40% and instantly dealing 145 Fire damage to the enemy.

name: Crusader's Judgment
description: Judgment now has 2 charges, and Grand Crusader now also reduces the cooldown of Judgment by 3 sec.

name: Rend and Tear
description: Each stack of Thrash reduces the target's damage to you by 3% and increases your damage to them by 2%.

name: Consecrated Ground
description: Your Consecration is 15% larger, and enemies within it have 50% reduced movement speed.

name: Lunar Beam
description: Summons a beam of lunar light at your target's location, dealing 14 Arcane damage each second to your target and 13 to up to 5 other enemies within the beam. \n\nLunar Beam also increases your mastery by 18%, and heals you for 798 over 8 sec.

name: Righteous Protector
description: Avenging Wrath and Sentinel have 50% reduced cooldown and 40% reduced duration.

name: Final Stand
description: During Divine Shield, all targets within 15 yds are taunted.

name: Deathchill
description:
Your Remorseless Winter and Chains of Ice apply Deathchill, rooting the target in place for 4 sec.

Remorseless Winter 
All targets within 8 yards are afflicted with Deathchill when Remorseless Winter is cast.

Chains of Ice
When you Chains of Ice a target already afflicted by your Chains of Ice they will be afflicted by Deathchill.

name: Bullseye
description: When your abilities damage a target below 20% health, you gain 1% increased critical strike chance for 6 sec, stacking up to 30 times.

name: Windburst
description: Focuses the power of Wind through Thas'dorah, dealing 272 Physical damage to your target, and leaving behind a trail of wind for 5 sec that increases the movement speed of allies by 50%.

name: Voodoo Mastery
description: Your Hex target is slowed by 70% during Hex and for 6 sec after it ends.\n\nReduces the cooldown of Hex by 15 sec.

name: Counterstrike Totem
description: Summons a totem at your feet for 15 sec.\n\nWhenever enemies within 20 yards of the totem deal direct damage, the totem will deal 100% of the damage dealt back to attacker.

name: Grounding Totem
description: Summons a totem at your feet that will redirect all harmful spells cast within 30 yards on a nearby party or raid member to itself. Will not redirect area of effect spells. Lasts 3 sec.

name: Sigil of Flame
description:
Place a Sigil of Flame at the target location that activates after 2 sec.

Deals 27 Fire damage, and an additional 70 Fire damage over 8 sec, to all enemies affected by the sigil.

Generates 25 Fury.

name: Soul Rending
description: Leech increased by 6%.\n\nGain an additional 6% leech while Metamorphosis is active.

name: Ray of Frost
description: Channel an icy beam at the enemy for 3.6 sec, dealing 1,846 Frost damage every 0.45 sec.\n\nApplies 8 stacks of Freezing over its duration.

name: Arcane Familiar
description: Casting Arcane Intellect summons a Familiar that attacks your enemies and increases your maximum mana by 10% for 1 hour.

name: Lonely Winter
description: Spell damage increased by 3%.

name: Presence of Mind
description: Causes your next 2 Arcane Blasts to be instant cast.

name: Firestarter
description: Your Fireball and Pyroblast spells always deal a critical strike when the target is above 90% health.

name: Resonance
description: Arcane Barrage deals 8% increased damage per target it hits beyond the first.

name: Flame On
description: Fire Blast gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 2.0 sec.

name: Frozen Touch
description: Frostbolt grants you Fingers of Frost 25% more often and Brain Freeze 20% more often.

name: Ice Ward
description: Frost Nova now has 2 charges.

name: Void Torrent
description: Raise your dagger into the sky, channeling a torrent of void energy into the target for 1,146 Shadow damage over 4 sec. Insanity does not drain during this channel.\n\nRequires Voidform.

name: Eerie Fermentation
description: You gain up to 30% movement speed  and 15% magical damage reduction based on your current level of Stagger.

name: Reverse Entropy
description: Your spells have a chance to grant you 15% Haste for 8 sec.

name: Mecha-Bond Imprint Matrix
description: Allows you to tame pets in the Mechanical family.

name: Summon Darkglare
description: Summons a Darkglare from the Twisting Nether that increases the damage of your Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction by 20% while active.\n\nThe Darkglare will serve you for 20 sec, blasting its target for 1,857 Shadow damage, increased by 10% for every damage over time effect you have active on their current target.

name: Consumption
description: Strikes all enemies in front of you with a hungering attack that deals 87 Physical damage and heals you for 100% of that damage.

name: Wake of Ashes
description: Lash out with the Ashbringer, dealing 61 Radiant damage to all enemies within 12 yd in front of you, and reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.\n\nDemon and Undead enemies are stunned for 6 sec if struck by the Wake of Ashes.

name: Dominate Mind
description: Controls a mind up to 1 level above yours for 30 sec while still controlling your own mind. Does not work versus Demonic, Mechanical, or Undead beings or players. This spell shares diminishing returns with other disorienting effects.

name: Sheilun's Gift
description: Draws in all nearby clouds of mist generated by Sheilun, healing the target for 190 per cloud absorbed.

name: Desperate Instincts
description: Blur now reduces damage taken by an additional 10%.\n\nAdditionally, damage taken below 35% Health is reduced by 10%.

name: Stormkeeper
description: Raises The Fist of Ra-den to the sky and absorbs all nearby electric energy, causing your next 3 casts of Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning to be instant and deal 200% increased damage.

name: Odyn's Fury
description: Unleashes the fiery power Odyn bestowed the Warswords, dealing 182 Fire damage and an additional 29 Fire damage over 4 sec to all enemies within 14 yards.

name: Detainment
description: Imprison's PvP duration is increased by 1 sec, and targets become immune to damage and healing while imprisoned.

name: Reverse Magic
description: Removes all harmful magical effects from yourself and all nearby allies within 10 yards, and sends them back to their original caster if possible.

name: Cleansed by Flame
description: Immolation Aura dispels a magical effect on you when cast.

name: Everlasting Hunt
description: Dealing damage increases your movement speed by 15% for 3 sec.

name: Jagged Spikes
description: While Demon Spikes is active, melee attacks against you cause Physical damage equal to 30% of the damage taken back to the attacker.

name: Demonic Trample
description: Transform to demon form, moving at 175% increased speed for 3 sec, knocking down all enemies in your path and dealing 5 Physical damage.\n\nDuring Demonic Trample you are unaffected by snares but cannot cast spells or use your normal attacks. Shares charges with Infernal Strike.

name: Illidan's Grasp
description: You strangle the target with demonic magic, stunning them in place and dealing 392 Shadow damage over 5 sec while the target is grasped. Can move while channeling.\n\nUse Illidan's Grasp again to toss the target to a location within 20 yards.

name: Force of Nature
description: Summons a stand of 3 Treants for 10 sec which immediately taunt and attack enemies in the targeted area.\n\nGenerates 20 Astral Power.

name: Savage Momentum
description: Interrupting a spell with Skull Bash reduces the remaining cooldown of Tiger's Fury, Survival Instincts, and Dash by 10 sec.

name: Chilled
description: Chilled, reducing movement speed by $s1% for $d.

name: Red Thirst
description: Reduces the cooldown on Vampiric Blood by 2.0 sec per 10 Runic Power spent.

name: Anti-Magic Barrier
description: Reduces the cooldown of Anti-Magic Shell by 20 sec and increases its duration and amount absorbed by 40%.

name: Oppressor
description: You focus the assault on this target, increasing their damage taken by 3% for 6 sec. Each unique player that attacks the target increases the damage taken by an additional 3%, stacking up to 5 times.\n\nYour melee attacks refresh the duration of Focused Assault.

name: Massacre
description: Execute is usable on targets below 35% health and its cooldown is reduced by 1.5 sec.

name: First Blood
description: Blade Dance deals 95 Chaos damage to the first target struck.

name: Exergy
description: The Hunt and Vengeful Retreat increase your damage by 5% for 20 sec.

name: Dragon Charge
description: Run at high speed at a distance in front of you. All enemies in your path will take 24 Physical damage and be knocked back.

name: Electrocute
description: When you successfully Purge a beneficial effect, the enemy suffers 2,154 Nature damage over 3 sec.

name: Rain from Above
description: You fly into the air out of harm's way. While floating, you gain access to Fel Lance allowing you to deal damage to enemies below.

name: Heart Strike
description: Instantly strike the target and 1 other nearby enemy, causing 55 Physical damage, and reducing enemies' movement speed by 20% for 8 sec.

name: Will of the Necropolis
description: Damage taken below 30% Health is reduced by 20%.

name: Foul Bulwark
description: Each charge of Bone Shield increases your maximum health by 1%.

name: Alpha Challenge
description: You focus the assault on this target, increasing their damage taken by 3% for 6 sec. Each unique player that attacks the target increases the damage taken by an additional 3%, stacking up to 5 times.\n\nYour melee attacks refresh the duration of Focused Assault.

name: Murderous Intent
description: You focus the assault on this target, increasing their damage taken by 3% for 6 sec. Each unique player that attacks the target increases the damage taken by an additional 3%, stacking up to 5 times.\n\nYour melee attacks refresh the duration of Focused Assault.

name: Admonishment
description: You focus the assault on this target, increasing their damage taken by 3% for 6 sec. Each unique player that attacks the target increases the damage taken by an additional 3%, stacking up to 5 times.\n\nYour melee attacks refresh the duration of Focused Assault.

name: Inquisition
description: You focus the assault on this target, increasing their damage taken by 3% for 6 sec. Each unique player that attacks the target increases the damage taken by an additional 3%, stacking up to 5 times.\n\nYour melee attacks refresh the duration of Focused Assault.

name: Tormentor
description: You focus the assault on this target, increasing their damage taken by 3% for 6 sec. Each unique player that attacks the target increases the damage taken by an additional 3%, stacking up to 5 times.\n\nYour melee attacks refresh the duration of Focused Assault.

name: Shattering Blade
description: When Frost Strike damages an enemy with 5 stacks of Razorice it will consume them to deal an additional 115% damage.\n\nFrostbane consumes the Razorice on your main target to deal an additional 300% damage.

name: Murderous Efficiency
description: Consuming the Killing Machine effect has a 20% chance to grant you 1 Rune.

name: Titan's Thunder
description: Discharge a massive jolt of electricity from Titanstrike into all your pets and Dire Beasts, causing them to deal up to 20 Nature damage to their target every 1 sec. for 8 sec.

name: Runic Attenuation
description: Auto attacks have a chance to generate 3 Runic Power.

name: Avalanche
description: Casting Howling Blast with Rime active causes jagged icicles to fall on enemies nearby your target, applying Razorice and dealing 7 Frost damage.

name: Blinding Sleet
description: Targets in a cone in front of you are blinded, causing them to wander disoriented for 5 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.\n\nWhen Blinding Sleet ends, enemies are slowed by 50% for 6 sec.

name: Permafrost
description: Your auto attack damage grants you an absorb shield equal to 40% of the damage dealt.

name: Frostscythe

Gather earthen power beneath your enemy's feet and send them hurtling upwards, dealing 1,626 Volcanic damage to the target and nearby enemies.

Empowering expands the area of effect.

I:   3 yd radius.

II:  6 yd radius.

III: 9 yd radius.

name: Reckless Abandon
description:
Activating Recklessness generates 50 Rage and while Recklessness is active, Raging Blow and Bloodthirst are upgraded to Crushing Blow and Bloodbath.

 Crushing Blow
Deals increased damage and deals 20% additional critical strike damage.

 Bloodbath
Deals increased damage and wounds the target to suffer 21 Bleed damage over 6 sec. Using Bloodbath on a target affected by Bloodbath extends the bleed by 6 sec.

name: Defender's Aegis
description: Shield Wall gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 60 sec.

name: Inner Peace
description: Increases maximum Energy by 30. Tiger Palm's Energy cost reduced by 5.

name: Burst of Life
description: When Life Cocoon expires, it releases a burst of mist that restores 3,062 health to 3 nearby allies.

name: Sheilun's Gift
description: Draws in all nearby clouds of mist, healing the friendly target and up to 2 nearby allies for 1,584 and an additional 79 per cloud absorbed.\n\nA cloud of mist is generated every 8 sec while in combat.

name: Veil of Pride
description: Increases Sheilun's Gift cloud of mist generation to every 4 sec.

name: Cosmic Rapidity
description: Your Moonfire and Sunfire deal damage 20% more frequently, also increasing the rate that Shooting Stars fall.

name: Forestwalk
description: Casting Regrowth increases your movement speed and healing received by 8% for 6 sec.

name: Incessant Tempest
description: Reduces the cooldown of Typhoon by 5 sec.

name: Gale Winds
description: Increases Typhoon's radius by 20% and its range by 5 yds.

name: Overpowering Finish
description: Overpower deals 15% additional damage to targets below 35% health.

name: Raze
description: Strike with the might of Ursoc, dealing 74 Physical damage to your target and 40 to all other enemies in front of you. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

name: Moonless Night
description: Your direct damage melee abilities against enemies afflicted by Moonfire cause them to burn for an additional 20% Arcane damage.

name: Circle of Life and Death
description: Your damage over time effects deal their damage in 20% less time, and your healing over time effects in 15% less time.

name: Salvo
description:
Volley now also applies Explosive Shot to up to 2 targets hit.

 Explosive Shot
Fires an explosive shot at your target. After 3 sec, the shot will explode, dealing 200 Fire damage to all enemies within 8 yds. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

name: Wild Synthesis
description: Grove Guardians, Efflorescence, and your other summons heal for 30% more.

name: Spirit of the Ox
description:
Blackout Kick has a chance to summon a Healing Sphere.

Healing Sphere:
Summon a Healing Sphere visible only to you. Moving through this Healing Sphere heals you for 117.

name: Strength of Arms
description: Overpower and Slam damage increased by 5% and critical strike damage increased by 5%.\nCritical strike chance of Slam and Overpower increased by 5%.

name: Unbreakable Stride
description: Reduces the duration of movement slowing effects 30%.

name: Righteous Cause
description: Each Holy Power spent has a 6% chance to reset the cooldown of Blade of Justice.

name: Sanctified Plates
description: Armor increased by 10%, Stamina increased by 5% and damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 3%.

name: Jurisdiction
description: Templar's Verdict and Blade of Justice deal 10% increased damage.\n\nThe range of Blade of Justice is increased to 20 yds.

name: Blessed Champion
description: Crusader Strike and Judgment hit an additional 4 targets but deal 25% reduced damage to secondary targets.

name: Burning Crusade
description: Your damage over time effects deal 10% more damage.

name: Draconic Attunements
description:
Learn to attune yourself to the essence of the Black or Bronze Dragonflights:

Black Attunement: You and your 4 nearest allies have 2% increased maximum health.

Bronze Attunement:You and your 4 nearest allies have 10% increased movement speed.

name: Lightforged Blessing
description: Divine Storm heals you and up to 2 nearby allies for 35.

name: Judgment of Justice
description: Judgment deals 10% increased damage and increases your movement speed by 10% for 5 sec.\n\nIf you have Greater Judgment, Judgment slows enemies by 30% for 8 sec.

name: Zealot's Fervor
description: Auto-attack speed increased by 20%.

name: Tranquil Mind
description: Increases Omen of Clarity's chance to activate Clearcasting to 5% and Clearcasting can stack 1 additional time.

name: Punishment
description: Successfully interrupting an enemy with Rebuke casts an extra Crusader Strike.

name: Breath of Eons
description:
Fly to the targeted location, exposing a Temporal Wound on enemies in your path for 10 sec.

Removes roots and grants immunity to movement impairing and loss of control effects while flying.

 Temporal Wound
15% of damage dealt by allies affected by Ebon Might is copied as additional Arcane damage to enemies after 10 sec.

Damage is reduced if Ebon Might affects more than 2 other allies.

name: Blades of Light
description: Crusader Strike, Judgment and Blade of Justice deal 10% increased damage.

name: Improved Blade of Justice
description: Blade of Justice now has 2 charges.

name: Blade of Vengeance
description: Blade of Justice now hits nearby enemies for 20 Holy damage. \n\nDeals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

name: Divine Protection
description: Reduces all damage you take by 20% for 8 sec. Usable while stunned.

name: Defy Fate
description:
Fatal attacks are diverted into a nearby timeline, preventing the damage, and your death, in this one.

The release of temporal energy restores 9,941 health to you, and 3,263 to 4 nearby allies, over 9 sec. Healing starts high and declines over the duration.

May only occur once every 6 min.

name: Guided Prayer
description: When your health is brought below 25%, you instantly cast a free Word of Glory at 60% effectiveness on yourself.\n\nCannot occur more than once every 60 sec.

name: Legacy of Wisdom
description: Sheilun's Gift heals 2 additional allies and its cast time is reduced by 0.5 sec.

name: Light of Justice
description: Reduces the cooldown of Blade of Justice by 2 sec.

name: Highlord's Wrath
description: Mastery: Highlord's Judgment is 50% more effective on Judgment and Hammer of Wrath. Judgment applies an additional stack of Greater Judgment if it is known.

name: Rampant Growth
description: Regrowth's healing over time is increased by 100%, and it also applies to the target of your Lifebloom.

name: Crusading Strikes
description: Crusader Strike replaces your auto-attacks and deals 81 Physical damage, but you auto-attack 20% slower.

name: Time Skip
description: Surge forward in time, causing your cooldowns to recover 1,000% faster for 2 sec.

name: Overflowing Power
description:
Go Berserk for $d. While Berserk:

Generate $343216s1 combo $lpoint:points; every $t1 sec. Combo point generating abilities generate $s2 additional combo $lpoint:points;. Finishing moves restore up to $405189u combo points generated over the cap.

All attack and ability damage is increased by $s3%.

name: Boundless Judgment
description: Judgment has a 50% increased chance to trigger Mastery: Highlord's Judgment.

name: Seething Flames
description: Wake of Ashes deals significantly reduced damage to secondary targets, but now causes you to lash out 2 extra times for 79 Radiant damage.

name: Improved Judgment
description: Judgment now has 2 charges.

name: Art of War
description: Your auto attacks have a 15% chance to reset the cooldown of Blade of Justice.\n\nCritical strikes increase the chance by an additional 10%.

name: Faith's Armor
description: Word of Glory grants 20% bonus armor for 4.5 sec.

name: Heart of the Crusader
description: Crusader Strike and auto-attacks deal 10% increased damage and deal 10% increased critical strike damage.

name: Judge, Jury and Executioner
description: Holy Power spending abilities deal 5% increased damage.\n\nAfter casting Execution Sentence, your next 1 Holy Power ability will refund its Holy Power cost.

name: Lightforged Blessing
description: Shield of the Righteous heals you and up to 2 nearby allies for 35.

name: Holy Flames
description: You deal 5% increased Holy damage to targets burning from your Expurgation.

name: Templar Strikes
description: Crusader Strike loses a charge but is now a combo ability.\n\nTemplar Strike slashes an enemy for 44 Radiant damage and gets followed up by Templar Slash that deals 51 Radiant damage. Templar Slash always critically strikes.

name: Ricocheting Pyroclast
description: Eruption deals 30% more damage per enemy struck, up to 150%.

name: Spatial Paradox
description: Evoke a paradox for you and a friendly healer, allowing casting while moving and increasing the range of most spells by 100% for 10 sec.\n\nAffects the nearest healer within 60 yds, if you do not have a healer targeted.

name: Thought Harvester
description: Mind Blast gains an additional charge.

name: Divine Wrath
description: Increases the duration of Avenging Wrath or Crusade by 4 sec.

name: Wild Surges
description: Your Wrath and Starfire chance to critically strike is increased by 10% and they generate 2 additional Astral Power.

name: Volcanism
description: Eruption's Essence cost is reduced by 1.

name: Regenerative Chitin
description: Blistering Scales no longer loses charges and deals 20% more damage.

name: Sticky Tar Bomb
description: Throw a Sticky Tar Bomb that coats your target's weapons with tar, disarming them for 4 sec. \n\nAfter 4 sec, Sticky Tar Bomb explodes onto nearby enemies. Other enemies that are hit by the explosion are affected by Sticky Tar Bomb but this effect cannot spread further.

name: Rush of Light
description: The critical strikes of your Holy Power generating abilities grant you 5% Haste for 10 sec.

name: Aspects' Favor
description: Obsidian Scales activates Black Attunement, and amplifies it to increase maximum health by 4.0% for 12 sec.\n\nHover activates Bronze Attunement, and amplifies it to increase movement speed by 25% for 4 sec.

name: Bronze Aspect's Favor
description: Obsidian Scales activates Black Attunement, and amplifies it to increase maximum health by $<blacktotal>% for $407254d.\n\nHover activates Bronze Attunement, and amplifies it to increase movement speed by $<bronzetotal>% for $407244d.

name: Black Aspect's Favor
description: Obsidian Scales activates Black Attunement, and amplifies it to increase maximum health by $<blacktotal>% for $407254d.\n\nHover activates Bronze Attunement, and amplifies it to increase movement speed by $<bronzetotal>% for $407244d.

name: In the Rhythm
description: When Rapid Fire finishes channeling, your critical strike chance is increased by 6% for 8 sec.

name: Bloody Frenzy
description: Bestial Wrath causes your Barbed Shot to deal damage 100% faster for 10 sec.

name: Voidtouched
description: Increases your Shadow Word: Madness damage by 6% and increases your maximum Insanity by 50.

name: Spectral Horrors
description: Shadow Apparitions deal 30% increased damage to targets affected by your Shadow Word: Madness.

name: Mind's Eye
description: Reduces the Insanity cost of Shadow Word: Madness by 5.

name: Icy Feet
description: When your Frost Nova or Water Elemental's Freeze is dispelled or removed, become immune to snares for 3 sec. \n\nThis effect can only occur once every 10 sec.

name: Pupil of Alexstrasza
description: When cast at an enemy, Living Flame strikes 1 additional enemy for 100% damage.

name: Plot the Future
description: Deep Breath grants you Fury of the Aspects for 15 sec after you land, without causing Exhaustion.

name: Anachronism
description: Prescience has a 35% chance to grant Essence Burst.

name: Accretion
description: Eruption reduces the remaining cooldown of Upheaval by 1.0 sec.

name: Tectonic Locus
description: Upheaval deals 50% increased damage to the primary target, and launches them higher.

name: Momentum Shift
description: Consuming Essence Burst grants you 5% Intellect for 6 sec. Stacks up to 2 times.

name: Font of Magic
description: Your empower spells' maximum level is increased by 1, and they reach maximum empower level 20% faster.

name: Bestow Weyrnstone
description: Conjure a pair of Weyrnstones, one for your target ally and one for yourself. Only one ally may bear your Weyrnstone at a time.\n\nA Weyrnstone can be activated by the bearer to transport them to the other Weyrnstone's location, if they are within 100 yds.

name: Divine Purpose
description: Holy Power spending abilities have a 10% chance to make your next Holy Power spending ability free and deal 10% increased damage and healing.

name: Seismic Slam
description: Landslide causes enemies who are mid-air to be slammed to the ground, stunning them for 4 sec and Landslide's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.

name: Phase Shift
description: Step into the shadows when you cast Fade, avoiding all attacks and spells for 1 sec.\n\nInterrupt effects are not affected by Phase Shift.

name: Ignition Rush
description: Essence Burst reduces the cast time of Eruption by 40% and increases its damage by 20%.

name: Absolute Faith
description: Leap of Faith also pulls the spirit of the 3 furthest allies within 40 yards and shields you and the affected allies for 2,851.

name: Distorted Reality
description: Increases the damage of Shadow Word: Madness by 20% and causes it to deal its damage over 12 sec, but increases its Insanity cost by 5.

name: Motes of Possibility
description: Eruption has a 25% chance to form a mote of diverted essence near you. Allies who comes in contact with the mote gain a random buff from your arsenal.

name: Burrow
description: Burrow beneath the ground, becoming unattackable, removing movement impairing effects, and increasing your movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.\n\nWhen the effect ends, enemies within 6 yards are knocked in the air and take 2,508 Physical damage.

name: Prescience
description: Grant an ally the gift of foresight, increasing their critical strike chance by 3% for 18 sec.\n\nAffects the nearest ally within 25 yds, preferring damage dealers with their cooldowns active, if you do not have an ally targeted.

name: Reactive Hide
description: Each time Blistering Scales explodes it deals 15% more damage for 12 sec, stacking 10 times.

name: Chrono Ward
description: When allies deal damage with Temporal Wounds, they gain a shield for 100% of the damage dealt. Absorption cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

name: Impish Instincts
description: Taking direct Physical damage reduces the cooldown of Demonic Circle by 3 sec.\n\nCannot occur more than once every 5 sec.

name: Searing Glare
description: Call upon the light to blind enemy players in a 25 yd cone, causing enemies to miss their spells and attacks for 4 sec.

name: Master Shepherd
description: While an enemy player is affected by your Polymorph or Mass Polymorph, your movement speed is increased by 25% and your Versatility is increased by 12%. \n\nAdditionally, Polymorph and Mass Polymorph no longer heal enemies.

name: Perilous Fate
description: Breath of Eons reduces enemies' movement speed by 70%, and reduces their attack speed by 50%, for 10 sec.

name: Overlord
description: Deep Breath casts an Eruption at the first 3 enemies struck. These Eruptions have a 100% chance to create a Mote of Possibility.

name: Inferno's Blessing
description: Fire Breath grants the inferno's blessing for 8 sec to you and a nearby ally, giving their damaging attacks and spells a high chance to deal an additional 1,022 Fire damage.

name: Bloodforged Armor
description: Death Strike reduces all Physical damage taken by 25% for 4 sec.

name: Spellwarden
description: Anti-Magic Shell is now usable on allies and its cooldown is reduced by 10 sec.

name: Hot Trub
description: Purifying Brew deals 20% of cleared damage split among nearby enemies. After clearing 100% of your maximum health in Stagger damage, your next Breath of Fire incapacitates targets for 4 sec.

name: Stretch Time
description: While flying during Deep Breath, 100% of damage you would take is instead dealt over 10 sec.

name: Dying Stars
description: Enemies that dispel your Moonfire or Sunfire suffer 25% additional damage from their effects for 12 sec. If already vulnerable, 50% of the remaining duration is applied to the dispeller.

name: Soul Rip
description: Fracture the soul of up to 3 target players within 20 yds into the shadows, reducing their damage done by 25% and healing received by 25% for 8 sec. Souls are fractured up to 20 yds from the player's location.\n\nPlayers can retrieve their souls to remove this effect.

name: Molten Blood
description: When cast, Blistering Scales grants the target a shield that absorbs up to 4,560 damage for 30 sec based on their missing health. Lower health targets gain a larger shield.

name: Symbiotic Bloom
description: Emerald Blossom increases targets' healing received by 3% for 10 sec.

name: Prolong Life
description: Your effects that extend Ebon Might also extend Symbiotic Bloom.

name: Echoing Strike
description: Azure Strike deals 15% increased damage and has a 10% chance per target hit to echo, casting again.

name: Ethereal Blink
