description: Blink and Shimmer apply Slow at 100% effectiveness to all enemies you Blink through. For each enemy you Blink through, the cooldown of Blink and Shimmer are reduced by 1 sec, up to 5 sec.

name: Event Horizon
description: Eternity Surge's cooldown is reduced by 3 sec.

name: Eye of Infinity
description: Eternity Surge deals 15% increased damage to your primary target.

name: Font of Magic
description: Your empower spells' maximum level is increased by 1, and they reach maximum empower level 20% faster.

name: Master Shapeshifter
description:
Your abilities are amplified based on your current shapeshift form, granting an additional effect.

 Caster Form
Rejuvenation heals for 30% more and generates 8 Astral Power.

 Bear Form
Ironfur grants 30% additional armor and generates 12 Astral Power.

 Cat Form
Rip, Ferocious Bite, and Maim deal 60% additional damage and generate 60 Astral Power when cast with 5 combo points.

name: Enduring Rage
description: You have a chance to become Enraged while you are suffering movement impairing effects.\n\nSuffering loss of control effects have a chance to grant you Recklessness for 5 sec.

name: Timelessness
description: Enchant an ally to appear out of sync with the normal flow of time, reducing threat they generate by 30% for 1 hour. Less effective on tank-specialized allies. \n\nMay only be placed on one target at a time.

name: Interwoven Threads
description: The cooldowns of your spells are reduced by 10%.

name: Tomorrow, Today
description: Time Skip channels for 1 sec longer.

name: Unyielding Domain
description: Upheaval cannot be interrupted, and has an additional 10% chance to critically strike.

name: Fate Mirror
description: Prescience grants the ally a chance for their spells and abilities to echo their damage or healing, dealing 15% of the amount again.

name: Light's Conviction
description: Holy Shock now has 2 charges and it refunds 50% of its mana cost when cast on an enemy.

name: Righteous Judgment
description: Judgment has a 100% chance to cast Consecration at the target's location.\n\nThe limit on Consecration does not apply to this effect.

name: Yu'lon's Grace
description: Find resilience in the flow of chi in battle, gaining a magic absorb shield for 1.0% of your max health every 3 sec in combat, stacking up to 10%.

name: Dance of the Wind
description: Your dodge chance is increased by 5%.

name: Awakening
description: While in combat, your Holy Power spenders have a 10% chance to cause your next Judgment to deal 30% increased damage and critically strike.\n\nActivating Avenging Wrath activates Awakening.

name: Concentrated Power
description: Arcane Missiles channels 20% faster.

name: Shining Righteousness
description: Shield of the Righteous deals 956 damage to its first target struck.\n\nShield of the Righteous now has a 35% chance to activate Divine Purpose if talented.

name: Epiphany
description: Your Holy Words have a 25% chance to cause your next cast of Prayer of Mending to ignore its cooldown.

name: Ice Cold
description: Ice Block now reduces all damage taken by 70% for 6 sec but no longer grants Immunity, prevents movement, attacks, or casting spells. Does not incur the Global Cooldown.

name: Mass Barrier
description: Cast Prismatic Barrier on yourself and 4 allies within 40 yds.

name: Mass Invisibility
description: You and your allies within 40 yards instantly become invisible for 12 sec. Taking any action will cancel the effect.\n\nDoes not affect allies in combat.

name: Tirion's Devotion
description: Lay on Hands' cooldown is reduced by 30% and restores 5% of your Mana.

name: Born in Flame
description: Casting Ebon Might grants 2 charges of Burnout, reducing the cast time of Living Flame by 100%.

name: Dream of Spring
description: Emerald Blossom no longer has a cooldown, deals 35% increased healing, and increases the duration of your active Ebon Might effects by 1 sec, but costs 3 Essence.

name: Divine Plea
description: After casting Aura Mastery, you restore 6,428 Mana over 30 sec, but your healing and damage is decreased by 30%.

name: Reclamation
description: Holy Shock refunds up to 10% of its Mana cost and deals up to 50% more healing or damage, based on the target's missing health.

name: Benevolence
description: Increases the healing of your spells by 3%.

name: Dreamwalker's Embrace
description: Verdant Embrace tethers you to an ally, increasing movement speed by 40% and slowing and siphoning 475 life from enemies who come in contact with the tether.\n\nThe tether lasts up to 10 sec or until you move more than 30 yards away from your ally.

name: Improved Mass Invisibility
description: The cooldown of Mass Invisibility is reduced by 4 min and can affect allies in combat.

name: Fuel the Fire
description: Flamestrike has a chance equal to 100% of your spell critical strike chance to build up to a Hot Streak.\n\nFlamestrike deals 5% increased damage for each enemy it damages, up to 25%.

name: Imp-erator
description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Wild Imp's Fel Firebolt by 15%.

name: Xavius' Gambit
description: Reduces the cast time of Unstable Affliction by 0.15 sec and increases its damage by 5%.

name: Intensifying Flame
description: While Ignite is on 3 or fewer enemies it flares up dealing an additional 30% of its damage to affected targets.

name: Blast Zone
description: Meteor's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.

name: Crashing Chaos
description: Summon Infernal increases the damage of your next 8 casts of Chaos Bolt by 25% or your next 8 casts of Rain of Fire by 35%.

name: Inflame
description: Hot Streak increases the amount of Ignite damage from Pyroblast or Flamestrike by an additional 25%.

name: Winter's Blessing
description: Your Haste is increased by 3%.\n\nYou gain 5% more Haste from all sources of Haste.

name: Awestruck
description: Holy Shock, Holy Light, and Flash of Light critical healing increased by 20%.

name: Potent Mana
description: Source of Magic increases the target's healing and damage done by 3%.

name: Press the Advantage
description: Your main hand auto attacks reduce the cooldown on your Brews by 0.50 sec and block your target's chi, dealing 10 additional Nature damage.\n\nAfter 10 attacks, the next casts Tiger Palm at 100% effectiveness.

name: Splintering Ray
description: Ray of Frost deals 30% of its damage to 5 nearby enemies.

name: Seraphic Crescendo
description: Reduces the cooldown of Divine Hymn by 60 sec.

name: Saber Jaws
description: When you spend extra Energy on Ferocious Bite, the extra damage is increased by 50%.

name: Ultimate Penitence
description: Ascend into the air and unleash a massive barrage of Penance bolts, causing 17,351 Holy damage to enemies or 40,757 healing to allies over 5.4 sec.\n\nWhile ascended, gain a shield for 100% of your health. In addition, you are unaffected by knockbacks or crowd control effects.

name: Caustic Spatter
description: Envenom or Kingsbane apply Caustic Spatter for 10 sec. Limit 1.\n\nCaustic Spatter causes 20% of your Nature damage dealt to splash onto other nearby enemies, reduced beyond 5 targets.

name: Energizing Brew
description: Mana Tea now channels 50% faster and generates 20% more Mana.

name: Path of Blood
description: Increases maximum Energy by 50.

name: Sudden Demise
description: Bleed damage increased by 10%.\n\nTargets below 35% health instantly bleed out and take fatal damage when the remaining Bleed damage you would deal to them exceeds 150% of their remaining health.

name: Graceful Guile
description: Feint has 1 additional charge.

name: Stillshroud
description: Shroud of Concealment has 50% reduced cooldown.

name: Featherfoot
description: Sprint increases movement speed by an additional 30% and has 4 sec increased duration.

name: Superior Mixture
description: Crippling Poison reduces movement speed by an additional 10%.

name: Boundless Moonlight
description:
Fury of Elune
Fury of Elune now ends with a flash of energy, blasting nearby enemies for 822 Astral damage.

 Full Moon
Full Moon calls down 2 Minor Moons that deal 718 Astral damage and generate 3 Astral Power.

name: The Eternal Moon
description:
Further increases the power of Boundless Moonlight.

 Fury of Elune
The flash of energy now generates 6 Astral Power and its damage is increased by 50%.

 Full Moon
New Moon and Half Moon now also call down 1 Minor Moon.

name: Savagery
description: Kill Command damage is increased by 10%. Barbed Shot lasts 2.0 sec longer.

name: Master Handler
description: Each time Barbed Shot deals damage, the cooldown of Kill Command is reduced by 0.50 sec.

name: Safeguard
description: Intervene now has 2 charges and reduces the ally's damage taken by 20% for 5 sec.\n\nIntervene's cooldown is increased by 10 sec.

name: Battlefield Commander
description:
Your Shout abilities have additional effects.

 Battle Shout:
Grants you an additional 3% attack power.

 Rallying Cry:
Grants an additional 2% health and duration increased by 3 sec.

 Piercing Howl:
Radius increased by 100%

 Berserker Shout:
Radius increased by 100%.

 Intimidating Shout:
Cooldown reduced by 15 sec.

name: Light's Deliverance
description: You gain a stack of Light's Deliverance when you call down an Empyrean Hammer.\n\nWhile Wake of Ashes and Hammer of Light are unavailable, you consume 60 stacks of Light's Deliverance, empowering yourself to cast Hammer of Light an additional time for free.

name: Demoniac
description:
Grants access to the following abilities:

 Demonbolt
Send the fiery soul of a fallen demon at the enemy, causing 1,537 Shadowflame damage.

 Demonic Core
When your Wild Imps fade or are imploded, you have a 10% chance to absorb their life essence, granting you a stack of Demonic Core. 

When your summoned Dreadstalkers fade away, you have a 100% chance to absorb their life essence, granting you a stack of Demonic Core.

Demonic Core reduces the cast time of Demonbolt by 100%. Maximum 4 stacks.

name: Jinx
description: Casting a curse now applies Corruption and Agony to your target, but curses now costs 1 Soul Shard.

name: Improved Mass Dispel
description: Reduces the cooldown of Mass Dispel by 60 sec.

name: Warning Signs
description: Shadow Dance increases attack speed by 25%.

name: Ephemeral Bond
description: Increases healing received by 8%.

name: Goremaw's Bite
description: Lashes out at the target, inflicting 114 Shadow damage and causing your next 3 finishing moves to cost no Energy.\n\nAwards 3 combo points.

name: Shadowcraft
description: While Shadow Dance is active, your Shadow Techniques triggers 40% more frequently, stores 1 additional combo point, and generates 2 additional Energy.

name: Liveliness
description: Your damage over time effects deal their damage 25% faster, and your healing over time effects heal 5% faster.

name: Call of the Elder Druid
description:
When you cast Starsurge, Rake, Shred, or Frenzied Regeneration you gain Call of the Elder Druid for 15 sec, once every 1 min.

 Call of the Elder Druid
Abilities not associated with your specialization are substantially empowered for 45 sec.

Balance: Cast time of Balance spells reduced by 30% and damage increased by 20%.

Feral: Gain 1 Combo Point every 2 sec while in Cat Form and Physical damage increased by 20%.

Guardian: Bear Form gives an additional 20% Stamina, multiple uses of Ironfur may overlap, and Frenzied Regeneration has 2 charges.

Restoration: Healing increased by 30%, and mana costs reduced by 50%.

name: Light's Guidance
description:
Wake of Ashes is replaced with Hammer of Light for 20 sec after it is cast.

 Hammer of Light:
Hammer down your enemy with the power of the Light, dealing 247 Holy damage and 121 Holy damage up to 7 nearby enemies. 

Additionally, calls down Empyrean Hammers from the sky to strike 3 nearby enemies for 16 Holy damage each.

Costs 5 Holy Power.

name: Inertia
description: The Hunt and Vengeful Retreat cause your next Fel Rush or Felblade to empower you, increasing damage by 18% for 5 sec.

name: A Fire Inside
description: Immolation Aura has 1 additional charge, has 6 sec reduced cooldown, and deals Chaos damage instead of Fire.\n\nYou can have multiple Immolation Auras active at a time.

name: Deflecting Dance
description: You deflect incoming attacks while Blade Dancing, absorbing damage up to 15% of your maximum health.

name: Dash of Chaos
description: For 2 sec after using Fel Rush, activating it again will dash back towards your initial location.

name: Scars of Suffering
description: Increases Versatility by 4% and reduces threat generated by 8%.

name: Demon Hide
description: Magical damage increased by 3%, and Physical damage taken reduced by 5%.

name: Precision Shot
description: Between the Eyes and Pistol Shot have 10 yd increased range and deal 20% increased damage.

name: Terrifying Pace
description: Shuriken Storm increases your movement speed by 30% for 3 sec when striking 3 or more enemies.

name: Spiteful Reconstitution
description: Increases Demonbolt damage by 10% and consuming a Demonic Core has a chance to summon a Wild Imp.

name: Exhilarating Execution
description: Your finishing moves heal you for 5% of damage done. At full health gain shielding instead, absorbing up to 10% of your maximum health.

name: Chaotic Disposition
description: Your Chaos damage has a 7.77% chance to be increased by 17%, occurring up to 3 total times.

name: Diabolic Ritual
description: Casting Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn grants Diabolic Ritual for 20 sec. If Diabolic Ritual is already active, its duration is reduced by 1 sec instead.\n\nWhen Diabolic Ritual expires you gain Demonic Art, causing your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn to summon an Overlord, Mother of Chaos, or Pit Lord that unleashes a devastating attack against your enemies.

name: Cloven Souls
description: Enemies damaged by your Overlord have their souls cloven, increasing damage taken by you and your pets by 5% for 15 sec.

name: Secrets of the Coven
description:
Mother of Chaos empowers your next Incinerate to become Infernal Bolt.

 Infernal Bolt
Hurl a bolt enveloped in the infernal flames of the abyss, dealing 5,119 Fire damage to your enemy target and generating 3 Soul Shards.

name: Ruination
description:
Summoning a Pit Lord causes your next Chaos Bolt to become Ruination.

 Ruination
Call down a demon-infested meteor from the depths of the Twisting Nether, dealing 9,644 Chaos damage on impact to all enemies within 8 yds of the target and summoning 3 Wild Imps.

Damage is reduced beyond 8 targets.

name: Treants of the Moon
description: Your Grove Guardians cast Moonfire on nearby targets about once every 6 sec.

name: Ascending Flame
description: Sigil of Flame damage increased by 50%.

name: Live by the Glaive
description: When you parry an attack or have one of your attacks parried, restore 2% of max health and 10 Fury. \n\nThis effect may only occur once every 5 sec.

name: The Light of Elune
description:
Moonfire damage has a chance to call down a Fury of Elune to follow your target for 3 sec.

 Fury of Elune
Calls down a beam of pure celestial energy, dealing 424 Astral damage over 3 sec within its area.

Generates 15 Astral Power over its duration.

name: Harmony of the Grove
description: Each of your Grove Guardians increases your healing done by 5% while active.

name: Power of Nature
description: Your Grove Guardians increase the healing of your Rejuvenation, Efflorescence, and Lifebloom by 10% while active.

name: Soul-Etched Circles
description: You always gain the benefit of Soulburn when casting Demonic Circle: Teleport, increasing your movement speed by 50% and making you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.

name: Early Spring
description: Swiftmend and Wild Growth cooldowns reduced by 1 sec.

name: Annihilan's Bellow
description: Howl of Terror cooldown is reduced by 10 sec and range is increased by 5 yds.

name: Infernal Vitality
description: Unending Resolve heals you for 30% of your maximum health over 10 sec.

name: Infernal Bulwark
description: Unending Resolve grants Soul Leech equal to 10% of your maximum health and increases the maximum amount Soul Leech can absorb by 10% for 8 sec.

name: Champion of the Glaive
description: Throw Glaive has 2 charges and 10 yard increased range.

name: Bounteous Bloom
description: Your Grove Guardians' healing is increased by 30%.

name: Durability of Nature
description: Your Force of Nature treants have 100% increased health.

name: Expansiveness
description: Your maximum mana is increased by 5%.

name: Grove's Inspiration
description: Wrath and Starfire damage increased by 10%. \n\nRegrowth, Wild Growth, and Swiftmend healing increased by 9%.

name: Potent Enchantments
description: Orbital Strike damage increased by 30%, and damage of Stellar Flares it applies increased by 30%.\n\nWhirling Stars increases the haste you gain during Celestial Alignment by an additional 10%.

name: Blooming Infusion
description: Every 5 Regrowths you cast makes your next Wrath, Starfire, or Entangling Roots instant and increases damage it deals by 100%.\n\nEvery 5 Starsurges you cast makes your next Regrowth or Entangling roots instant.

name: Warp
description: Hover now causes you to briefly warp out of existence and appear at your destination. Hover's cooldown is also reduced by 5 sec.\n\nHover continues to allow Evoker spells to be cast while moving.

name: Moon Guardian
description: Free automatic Moonfires from Galactic Guardian generate 5 Rage.

name: Lunar Calling
description: Thrash now deals Arcane damage and its damage is increased by 12%.

name: Lunar Insight
description: Moonfire deals 20% increased damage.

name: Atmospheric Exposure
description: Enemies damaged by Lunar Beam or Fury of Elune take 6% increased damage from you for 6 sec.

name: Glistening Fur
description: Bear Form and Moonkin Form reduce Arcane damage taken by 6% and all other magic damage taken by 3%.

name: Astral Insight
description: Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc increases Arcane damage from spells and abilities by 10% while active.\n\nIncreases the duration and number of spells cast by Convoke the Spirits by 25%.

name: Moondust
description: Enemies affected by Moonfire are slowed by 20%.

name: Lunation
description: Your Arcane abilities reduce the cooldown of Lunar Beam by 3.0 sec.

name: Arcane Affinity
description: All Arcane damage from your spells and abilities is increased by 3%.

name: Abyssal Dominion
description: Summon Infernal becomes empowered, dealing 40% increased damage. When your Summon Infernal ends, it fragments into two smaller Infernals at 50% effectiveness that lasts 10 sec.

name: Colossal Might
description: Colossal Might increases damage dealt by your next Demolish by 5%, stacking up to 5 times.\n\nMortal Strike grants a stack of Colossal Might and Cleave grants a stack of Colossal Might when it strikes 3 or more targets.

name: Dominance of the Colossus
description: Colossal Might stacks up to 10 times. If you would gain a stack of Colossal Might and are at max stacks, the cooldown of Demolish is reduced by 5 sec.\n\nEnemies affected by Demolish take up to 10% more damage from you and deal up to 10% less damage to you for 10 sec based on the number of stacks of Colossal Might consumed by Demolish.

name: One Against Many
description: Shockwave, Cleave, and Whirlwind deal 5% more damage per target affected up to 5.

name: Martial Expert
description: Critical strike damage of your abilities is increased by 10% and the amount of damage blocked by your critical blocks is increased by 20%.

name: Boneshaker
description: Shockwave's stun duration is increased by 1 sec and reduces the movement speed of affected enemies by 40% for 3 sec after the stun ends.

name: Tide of Battle
description: Colossal Might increases the damage of your Overpower by 3% per stack.

name: Mountain of Muscle and Scars
description: You deal 5% more damage and take 5% less damage.\n\nSize increased by 5%.

name: No Stranger to Pain
description: Damage prevented by each use of Ignore Pain is increased by 20%.

name: Practiced Strikes
description: Mortal Strike and Slam damage increased by 25%.\n\nCleave and Whirlwind damage increased by 15%.

name: Flames of Xoroth
description: Fire damage increased by 4% and damage dealt by your demons is increased by 4%.

name: Stellar Command
description: Increases the damage of Lunar Beam by 30% and Fury of Elune by 15%.

name: Touch of Rancora
description: Demonic Art increases the damage of your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn by 20% and reduces its cast time by 50%.\n\nCasting Chaos Bolt reduces the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.

name: Gloom of Nathreza
description: Enemies marked by your Havoc take 7% increased damage from your single target spells.

name: Cruelty of Kerxan
description: Summon Infernal grants Diabolic Ritual and reduces its duration by 3 sec.

name: Infernal Machine
description: Spending Soul Shards on damaging spells while your Infernal is active decreases the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.

name: Smoke Screen
description: Exhilaration grants you 3 sec of Survival of the Fittest.\n\nSurvival of the Fittest activates Exhilaration at 50% effectiveness.

name: Dark Chains
description: While in combat, Disengage will chain the closest target to the ground, causing them to move 40% slower until they move 8 yards away.

name: Frostfire Bolt
description: Launches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing 1,062 Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 50%, and causing an additional 99 Frostfire damage over 8 sec.

name: Imbued Warding
description: $?c2[Blazing Barrier also casts an Ice Barrier at $s1% effectiveness.]?c3[Ice Barrier also casts a Blazing Barrier at $s2% effectiveness.][]

name: Elemental Affinity
description: $?c2[The cooldown of Frost spells with a base cooldown shorter than $s4 minutes is reduced by $s1%.]?c3[The cooldown of Fire spells is reduced by $s3%.][]

name: Isothermic Core
description: Meteor now also calls down a Comet Storm, dealing 2,682 Frost damage to nearby enemies.\n\nComet Storm now also calls down a Meteor, dealing 3,721 Fire damage to nearby enemies.

name: Flame and Frost
description: Ice Block and Ice Cold reset the cooldowns of your Fire spells.\n\nCauterize resets the cooldown of your Frost spells with a base cooldown shorter than 4 minutes when it activates.

name: Thermal Conditioning
description: Frostfire Bolt's cast time is reduced by 10%.

name: Meltdown
description: You melt slightly out of your Ice Block and Ice Cold, allowing you to move slowly during Ice Block and increasing your movement speed over time.\n\nIce Block and Ice Cold trigger a Blazing Barrier when they end.

name: Frostfire Infusion
description: Frostfire Bolt has and additional 5% chance to grant Brain Freeze and its critical strike chance is increased by 15%.\n\nThe damage of your Frost spells and Fire spells are increased by 4%.

name: Frostfire Empowerment
description: Casting Frostfire spells has a 10% chance to activate Frostfire Empowerment, causing your next Frostfire Bolt to be instant cast, deal 60% increased damage, explode for 60% of its damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.\n\nDamage from Frostfire Empowerment applies 1 stack of Freezing.

name: Flash Freezeburn
description: Meteor's damage is increased by 25%.\n\nMeteor now grants Frostfire Empowerment.

name: Severe Temperatures
description: Frostfire Empowerment stacks 1 additional time and it causes Frostfire Bolt to explode for an additional 20% of its damage.

name: Dawnlight
description:
Casting Holy Prism or Divine Toll causes your next 2 Holy Power spending abilities to apply Dawnlight on your target, dealing 1,327 Radiant damage or 2,802 healing over 8 sec.

8% of Dawnlight's damage and healing radiates to nearby allies or enemies, reduced beyond 5 targets.

Dawnlight's healing does not transfer to Beacon of Light.

name: Luminosity
description: Critical Strike chance of Holy Shock and Light of Dawn increased by 5%.

name: Solar Grace
description: Haste is increased by 5%.

name: Will of the Dawn
description: Movement speed increased by 5% while above 80% health.\n\nWhen your health is brought below 35%, your movement speed is increased by 40% for 5 sec. Cannot occur more than once every 1 min.

name: Lingering Radiance
description: Dawnlight leaves an Eternal Flame for 6 sec on allies or a Greater Judgment on enemies when it expires or is extended.

name: Sun Sear
description: Holy Shock and Light of Dawn critical strikes cause the target to be healed for an additional 281 over 4 sec.

name: Illumine
description: Dawnlight reduces the movement speed of enemies by 50% and increases the movement speed of allies by 20%.

name: Sun's Avatar
description: You link to your Dawnlights within 30 yds, causing 82 Radiant damage to enemies or 141 healing to allies that pass through the beams, reduced beyond 5 targets.

name: Chrono Flame
description: Living Flame is enhanced with Bronze magic, repeating 25% of the damage or healing you dealt to the target in the last 5 sec as Arcane, up to 950.

name: Zealous Vindication
description: Hammer of Light instantly calls down 2 Empyrean Hammers on your target when it is cast.

name: Second Sunrise
description: Light of Dawn and Holy Shock have a 15% chance to cast again at 30% effectiveness.

name: Gleaming Rays
description: Your Holy Power spenders deal 3% additional damage and healing.

name: Morning Star
description: Every 5.0 sec, your next Dawnlight's damage or healing is increased by 5%, stacking up to 10 times.\n\nMorning Star stacks twice as fast while out of combat.

name: Instability Matrix
description: Each time you cast an empower spell, unstable time magic reduces its cooldown by up to 6 sec.

name: Shake the Heavens
description: After casting Hammer of Light, you call down an Empyrean Hammer on a nearby target every 2 sec, for 8 sec.

name: Precise Might
description: Mortal Strike critical strikes grant an additional stack of Colossal Might.

name: Wrathful Descent
description: When Empyrean Hammer critically strikes, 50% of its damage is dealt to nearby enemies.\n\nEnemies hit by this effect deal 5% reduced damage to you for 8 sec.

name: Reverberations
description: Upheaval deals 50% additional damage over 8 sec.

name: Primacy
description: For each damage over time effect from Upheaval, gain 3% haste, up to 9%.

name: Higher Calling
description: Crusader Strike, Hammer of Wrath and Blade of Justice extend the duration of Shake the Heavens by 1 sec.

name: Temporal Burst
description: Tip the Scales overloads you with temporal energy, increasing your haste, movement speed, and cooldown recovery rate by 30%, decreasing over 30 sec.

name: Nozdormu Adept
description: Prescience cooldown reduced by 2 sec and it grants 1% additional critical strike chance.

name: Sacrosanct Crusade
description: Wake of Ashes surrounds you with a Holy barrier for 10% of your maximum health.\n\nHammer of Light heals you for 5% of your maximum health, increased by 1% for each additional target hit. Any overhealing done with this effect gets converted into a Holy barrier instead.

name: Temporality
description: Warp reduces damage taken by 20%, starting high and reducing over 3 sec.

name: Double-time
description: Ebon Might and Prescience gain a chance equal to your critical strike chance to grant 50% additional stats.

name: Afterimage
description: Empower spells send up to 3 Chrono Flames to your targets.

name: Time Convergence
description: Non-defensive abilities with a 45 second or longer cooldown grant 5% Intellect for 15 sec.\n\nEssence spells extend the duration by 1 sec.

name: Golden Opportunity
description: Prescience lasts 15% longer.

name: Motes of Acceleration
description: Warp leaves a trail of Motes of Acceleration. Allies who come in contact with a mote gain 20% increased movement speed for 30 sec.

name: Dance of the Wind
description: Your physical damage taken is reduced by 10% and an additional 10% every 4 sec until you receive a physical attack.

name: Holy Bulwark
description:
Will the Light to coalesce and become manifest as a Holy Armament, wielded by your friendly target.

 Holy Bulwark:

While wielding a Holy Bulwark, gain an absorb shield for 15.0% of your max health and an additional 2.0% every 2 sec. Lasts 20 sec.

Becomes Sacred Weapon after use.

Generates 3 Holy Power.

name: Hammerfall
description: Templar's Verdict calls down an Empyrean Hammer on a nearby enemy.\n\nWhile Shake the Heavens is active, this effect calls down an additional Empyrean Hammer.

name: Endless Wrath
description: Empyrean Hammer has a 10% increased chance to critically strike.

name: Undisputed Ruling
description: Hammer of Light applies Judgment to its targets, and increases your Haste by 12% for 6 sec.

name: Solidarity
description: If you bestow an Armament upon an ally, you also gain its benefits.\n\nIf you bestow an Armament upon yourself, a nearby ally also gains its benefits.

name: Forewarning
description: The cooldown of Holy Armaments is reduced by 20%.

name: Shared Resolve
description: The effect of your active Aura is increased by 33% on targets with your Armaments.

name: Laying Down Arms
description: When an Armament fades from you, the cooldown of Lay on Hands is reduced by 15.0 sec and you gain Infusion of Light.

name: Valiance
description: Consuming Infusion of Light reduces the cooldown of Holy Armaments by 3.0 sec.

name: Divine Hammer
description:
Divine Toll summons Divine Hammers that spin around you for 8 sec.

Divine Hammer
Strikes all enemies nearby for 50 Holy damage every 2 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Divine Inspiration
description: Your spells and abilities have a chance to manifest a Holy Armament for a nearby ally.

name: Sanctification
description: Casting Judgment increases the damage of Empyrean Hammer by 5% for 10 sec.\n\nMultiple applications may overlap.

name: Unrelenting Charger
description: Divine Steed lasts 2 sec longer and increases your movement speed by an additional 30% for the first 3 sec.

name: Bonds of Fellowship
description: You receive 20% less damage from Blessing of Sacrifice and each time its target takes damage, you gain 4% movement speed up to a maximum of 40%.

name: Blessing of the Forge
description: Avenging Wrath summons an additional Sacred Weapon, and during Avenging Wrath your Sacred Weapon casts spells on your target and echoes the effects of your Holy Power abilities.

name: Blessed Assurance
description: Casting a Holy Power ability increases the damage and healing of your next Crusader Strike by 200%.

name: Divine Guidance
description: For each Holy Power ability cast, your next Consecration deals 1,140 damage or healing immediately, split across all enemies and allies.

name: Rite of Sanctification
description: Imbue your weapon with the power of the Light, increasing your armor by 5% and your primary stat by 2%.\n\nLasts 1 hour.

name: Rite of Adjuration
description: Imbue your weapon with the power of the Light, increasing your Stamina by 3% and causing your Holy Power abilities to sometimes unleash a burst of healing around a target.\n\nLasts 1 hour.

name: Hammer and Anvil
description: Judgment critical strikes cause a shockwave around the target, healing to up to 5 injuried allies for 430.

name: Protective Growth
description: Your Regrowth protects you, reducing damage you take by 8% while your Regrowth is on you.

name: Dream Surge
description: When Grove Guardians are summoned, they grow Dream Petals on your target, healing up to 3 nearby allies for 564.

name: Maneuverability
description:
Deep Breath can now be steered in your desired direction.

In addition, Deep Breath burns targets for 2,554 Volcanic damage over 12 sec.

The duration of this effect is extended when Deep Breath is cast multiple times.

name: Infernal Bolt
description:
Mother of Chaos empowers your next $?s137044[Shadow Bolt][Incinerate] to become Infernal Bolt.

$@spellicon434506 $@spellname434506
Hurl a bolt enveloped in the infernal flames of the abyss, dealing $s1 Fire damage to your enemy target and generating ${$s2/10} Soul Shards.

name: Vampiric Strike
description: Your Death Coil and Death Strike have a 25% chance to make your next Scourge Strike become Vampiric Strike.\n\nVampiric Strike heals you for 2% of your maximum health and grants you Essence of the Blood Queen, increasing your Haste by 1.0%, up to 5.0% for 20 sec.

name: Prophet's Will
description: Your Flash Heal and Holy Word: Serenity are 30% more effective when cast on yourself.

name: Newly Turned
description: Raise Ally revives players at full health and grants you and your ally an absorb shield equal to 20% of your maximum health.

name: Vampiric Speed
description: Death's Advance and Wraith Walk movement speed bonuses are increased by 10%.\n\nActivating Death's Advance or Wraith Walk increases 4 nearby allies movement speed by 20% for 5 sec.

name: Blood-Soaked Ground
description: While you are within your Death and Decay, your physical damage taken is reduced by 5% and your chance to gain Vampiric Strike is increased by 5%.

name: Frenzied Bloodthirst
description: Essence of the Blood Queen stacks 2 additional times and increases the damage of your Death Coil and Death Strike by 5%, and Epidemic by 5% per stack.

name: Vampiric Aura
description: Your Leech is increased by 2%.\n\nWhile Lichborne is active, the Leech bonus of this effect is increased by 100%, and it affects 4 allies within 12 yds.

name: Bloody Fortitude
description: Icebound Fortitude reduces all damage you take by up to an additional 20% based on your missing health.\n\nKilling an enemy that yields experience or honor reduces the cooldown of Icebound Fortitude by 3 sec.

name: Infliction of Sorrow
description: When Vampiric Strike damages an enemy affected by your plagues, it extends the duration of the plagues by 3.0 sec, and deals 10% of the remaining damage to the enemy.

name: Incite Terror
description: Vampiric Strike and Scourge Strike cause your targets to take 1% increased Shadow damage, up to 5% for 15 sec.\n\nVampiric Strike benefits from Incite Terror at 400% effectiveness.

name: Gift of the San'layn
description: While Dark Transformation is active you gain Gift of the San'layn.\n\nGift of the San'layn increases the effectiveness of your Essence of the Blood Queen by 200%, and Vampiric Strike replaces your Scourge Strike for the duration.

name: Visceral Strength
description: When Sudden Doom is consumed, you gain 4% Strength for 5 sec.

name: Power of the Dream
description: Dream Surge heals 1 additional ally.

name: Control of the Dream
description: Time elapsed while your major abilities are available to be used or at maximum charges is subtracted from that ability's cooldown after the next time you use it, up to 15 seconds.\n\nAffects Force of Nature, Celestial Alignment, and Convoke the Spirits.

name: The Blood is Life
description: Dark Transformation summons a Blood Beast to attack your enemy for 10 sec.\n\nEach time the Blood Beast attacks, it stores a portion of the damage dealt. When the Blood Beast dies, it explodes, dealing 25% of the damage accumulated to nearby enemies and healing the Death Knight for the same amount. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Pact of the San'layn
description: You store 10% of all Shadow damage dealt into your Blood Beast to explode for additional damage when it expires.

name: Sanguine Scent
description: Your Death Coil and Death Strike have a 15% increased chance to trigger Vampiric Strike when damaging enemies below 35% health.

name: Bombardments
description: Mass Disintegrate marks your primary target for destruction for the next 6 sec.\n\nYou and your allies have a chance to trigger a Bombardment when attacking marked targets, dealing 1,805 Volcanic damage split amongst all nearby enemies.

name: Cloven Soul
description: Enemies damaged by your Overlord have their souls cloven, increasing damage taken by you and your pets by $434424s1% for $434424d.

name: Summon Overfiend
description: Generates $457578s1 Soul Shard Fragment every $457578t1 sec and casts Chaos Bolt at $456975s1% effectiveness at its summoner's target. Lasts $d.

name: Transcendence: Linked Spirits
description: Transcendence now tethers your spirit onto an ally for 1 hour. Use Transcendence: Transfer to teleport to your ally's location.

name: Grim Reaper
description: Reaper's Mark initial strike grants Killing Machine.\n\nReaper's Mark explosion deals up to 30% increased damage based on your target's missing health.

name: Lightning Strikes
description: Damaging enemies with Thunder Clap, Raging Blow, or Execute has a 25% chance to also strike one with a lightning bolt, dealing 54 Nature damage.\n\nLightning Strikes occur 30% more often during Avatar.

name: Steadfast as the Peaks
description: Stamina increased by 5%.\n\nVictory Rush increases your maximum health by 10% for 5 sec. When this health increase expires, you heal for any amount of the original Victory Rush that healed you in excess of your full health.

name: Smothering Offense
description: Your auto attack damage is increased by 10%. \n\nThis amount is increased for each stack of Icy Talons you have and it can stack up to 2 additional times.

name: Icy Death Torrent
description: Your auto attack critical strikes have a chance to send out a torrent of ice dealing 37 Frost damage to enemies in front of you.

name: Thunder Blast
description:
Shield Slam and Bloodthirst have a 35% chance to grant you Thunder Blast, stacking up to 2 charges.

Thunder Blast
Your next Thunder Clap becomes a Thunder Blast that deals 67 Stormstrike damage and generates 2 Rage.

name: Ground Current
description: Lightning Strikes also deal 15 Nature damage to enemies near their target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

name: Thorim's Might
description: Lightning Strikes generate 3 Rage.\n\nRaging Blow and Execute damage increased by 25%.

name: Storm Bolts
description: Storm Bolt also hits 2 additional nearby targets, stunning them for 2 sec, but its cooldown is increased by 10 sec.

name: Gathering Clouds
description: Your attacks trigger Lightning Strikes 30% more often.

name: Mass Disintegrate
description: Empower spells cause your next Disintegrate to strike up to 3 targets. When striking fewer than 3 targets, Disintegrate damage is increased by 10% for each missing target.

name: Demolish
description:
Unleash a series of precise and powerful strikes against your target, dealing 802 damage to it, and 430 damage to enemies within 10 yds of it. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

While channeling Demolish, you take 10% less damage and are immune to stuns, knockbacks, and forced movement effects.

You can block, parry, dodge, and use certain defensive abilities while channeling Demolish.

name: Dark Talons
description: Consuming Killing Machine or Rime has a 25% chance to grant 3 stacks of Icy Talons and increase its maximum stacks by the same amount for 6 sec.\n\nRunic Power spending abilities count as Shadowfrost while Icy Talons is active.

name: Crashing Thunder
description: Stormstrike or Nature damage your abilities deal is increased by 5%. Stormstrike damage ignores Armor.\n\nThunder Clap damage increased by 30%.

name: Strength of the Mountain
description: Shield Slam damage increased by 15%.\n\nBloodthirst and Rampage damage increased by 25%.

name: Flashing Skies
description: Thunder Blast calls down a Lightning Strike on an enemy it hits.

name: Burst of Power
description: Lightning Strikes have a 15% chance to make your next 2 Bloodthirsts have no cooldown.

name: Death's Messenger
description: Reduces the cooldowns of Lichborne and Raise Dead by 30 sec.

name: Avatar of the Storm
description:
Casting Avatar grants you 2 charges of Thunder Blast and resets the cooldown of Thunder Clap.

While Avatar is not active, Lightning Strikes have a 10% chance to grant you Avatar for 4 secs.

Thunder Blast
Your next Thunder Clap becomes a Thunder Blast that deals Stormstrike damage.

name: Soul Rupture
description: When Reaper's Mark explodes, it deals 20% of the damage dealt to nearby enemies.

name: Dance of Chi-Ji
description: Your spells and abilities have a chance to make your next Spinning Crane Kick deal an additional 400% damage.

name: Mass Eruption
description: Empower spells cause your next Eruption to strike up to 3 targets. When striking less than 3 targets, Eruption damage is increased by 10% for each missing target.

name: Keep Your Feet on the Ground
description: Physical damage taken reduced by 2%.\n\nThunder Blast reduces damage you take by 8% for 5 sec.

name: Storm Shield
description: Intervening a target grants them a shield for 5 sec that absorbs magic damage equal to 3 times your Armor.

name: Thriving Growth
description:
Rip and Rake damage has a chance to cause Bloodseeker Vines to grow on the victim, dealing 34 Bleed damage over 6 sec.

Wild Growth, Regrowth, and Efflorescence healing has a chance to cause Symbiotic Blooms to grow on the target, healing for 834 over 6 sec.

Multiple instances of these can overlap.

name: Aurora
description:
After you cast Holy Prism or Divine Toll, gain Divine Purpose.

 Divine Purpose
Your next Holy Power spending ability is free and deals 15% increased damage and healing.

name: Reaper's Mark
description:
Viciously slice into the soul of your enemy, dealing 109 Shadowfrost damage and applying Reaper's Mark.

Each time you deal Shadow or Frost damage, add a stack of Reaper's Mark. After 12 sec or reaching 40 stacks, the mark explodes, dealing 14 damage per stack.

Reaper's Mark travels to an unmarked enemy nearby if the target dies.

name: Wave of Souls
description: Reaper's Mark sends forth bursts of Shadowfrost energy and back, dealing 34 Shadowfrost damage both ways to all enemies caught in its path.\n\nWave of Souls critical strikes cause enemies to take 5% increased Shadowfrost damage for 15 sec, stacking up to 2 times, and it is always a critical strike on its way back.

name: Hunt Beneath the Open Skies
description: Damage and healing while in Cat Form increased by 3%.\n\nMoonfire and Sunfire damage increased by 10%.

name: Resilient Flourishing
description: Bloodseeker Vines and Symbiotic Blooms last 2 additional sec.\n\nWhen a target afflicted by Bloodseeker Vines dies, the vines jump to a valid nearby target for their remaining duration.

name: Root Network
description: Each active Bloodseeker Vine increases the damage your abilities deal by 2%.\n\nEach active Symbiotic Bloom increases the healing of your spells by 2%.

name: Strategic Infusion
description: Attacking from Prowl increases the chance for Shred, Rake, and Swipe to critically strike by 8% for 6 sec.\n\nYour periodic heals have a 4% increased chance to critically heal.

name: Entangling Vortex
description: Enemies pulled into Ursol's Vortex are rooted in place for 3 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

name: Flower Walk
description: During Barkskin your movement speed is increased by 10% and every second flowers grow beneath your feet that heal up to 3 nearby injured allies for 76.

name: Wildstalker's Power
description: Rip and Ferocious Bite damage increased by 5%.\n\nRejuvenation healing increased by 10%.

name: Bond with Nature
description: Healing you receive is increased by 4%.

name: Expelling Shield
description: When an enemy deals direct damage to your Anti-Magic Shell, their cast speed is reduced by 10% for 6 sec.

name: Purify Disease
description: Removes all Disease effects from a friendly target.

name: Cleanse Spirit
description: Removes all Curse effects from a friendly target.

name: Cleanse Toxins
description: Cleanses a friendly target, removing all Poison and Disease effects..

name: Remove Corruption
description: Nullifies corrupting effects on the friendly target, removing all Curse and Poison effects.

name: Bind in Darkness
description: Rime empowered Howling Blast deals 60% increased damage to its main target, and is now Shadowfrost.\n\nShadowfrost damage applies 2 stacks to Reaper's Mark and 4 stacks when it is a critical strike.

name: Xalan's Cruelty
description: Shadow damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Shadow spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.

name: Blackened Soul
description: Spending Soul Shards on damaging spells will further corrupt enemies affected by your Wither, increasing its stack count by 1.\n\nEach time Wither gains a stack it has a chance to collapse, consuming a stack every 1 sec to deal 378 Shadowflame damage to its host until 1 stack remains.

name: Xalan's Ferocity
description: Fire damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Fire spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.

name: Mark of Peroth'arn
description: Critical strike damage dealt by Wither is increased by 10%. \n\nWither has a chance to gain a stack when it critically strikes. Stacks gained this way do not activate Blackened Soul.

name: Mark of Xavius
description: Wither damage increased by 25%.\n\nBlackened Soul deals 2% increased damage per stack of Wither.

name: Hatefury Rituals
description: Wither deals 30% increased periodic damage but its duration is 15% shorter.

name: Bleakheart Tactics
description: Wither damage increased 20%. When Wither gains a stack from Blackened Soul, it has a chance to gain an additional stack.

name: Seeds of Their Demise
description: After Wither reaches 8 stacks or when its host reaches 20% health, Wither deals 378 Shadowflame damage to its host every 1 sec until 1 stack remains.\n\nWhen Blackened Soul deals damage, you have a chance to gain Shard Instability.

name: Curse of the Satyr
description:
Curse of Weakness is empowered and transforms into Curse of the Satyr.

 Curse of the Satyr
Increases the time between an enemy's attacks by 20% and the casting time of all spells by 30% for 2 min.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.

name: Aura of Enfeeblement
description: While Unending Resolve is active, enemies within 30 yds are affected by Curse of Tongues and Curse of Weakness at 100% effectiveness.

name: Zevrim's Resilience
description: Dark Pact heals you for 625 every 1 sec while active.

name: Illhoof's Design
description: Sacrifice 10% of your maximum health. Soul Leech now absorbs an additional 15% of your maximum health.

name: Harmonious Constitution
description: Your Regrowth's healing to yourself is increased by 35%.

name: Twin Sprouts
description: When Bloodseeker Vines or Symbiotic Blooms grow, they have a 30% chance to cause another growth of the same type to immediately grow on a valid nearby target.

name: Implant
description: Casting Swiftmend or Wild Growth causes a Symbiotic Bloom to grow on a target for 6 sec.

name: Vigorous Creepers
description: Bloodseeker Vines increase the damage your abilities deal to affected enemies by 4%.\n\nSymbiotic Blooms increase the healing your spells do to affected targets by 20%.

name: Bursting Growth
description: When Bloodseeker Vines expire or you use Ferocious Bite on their target they explode in thorns, dealing 30 physical damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced above 5 targets.\n\nWhen Symbiotic Blooms expire or you cast Rejuvenation on their target flowers grow around their target, healing them and up to 3 nearby allies for 160.

name: Powerful Enrage
description: Enrage increases your mastery by 15% and your Leech by 3%.

name: Rune Carved Plates
description: Each Rune spent reduces the magic damage you take by 1.5% and each Rune generated reduces the physical damage you take by 1.5% for 5 sec, up to 5 times.

name: Pact of the Deathbringer
description: When you suffer a damaging effect equal to 25% of your maximum health, you instantly cast Death Pact at 50% effectiveness. May only occur every 2 min.\n\nWhen a Reaper's Mark explodes, the cooldowns of this effect and Death Pact are reduced by 5 sec.

name: Preventive Measures
description: Increases the healing done by Prayer of Mending by 15%.\n\nAll damage dealt by Smite, Holy Fire and Holy Nova increased by 40%.

name: Save the Day
description: For 6 sec after casting Leap of Faith you may cast it a second time for free, ignoring its cooldown.

name: Divine Feathers
description: Your Angelic Feathers increase movement speed by an additional 10%.\n\nWhen an ally walks through your Angelic Feather, you are also granted 100% of its effect.

name: Preemptive Care
description: Increases the duration of your Renew by 40%.

name: Waste No Time
description: Reduces the cooldown of Prayer of Mending by 1.5 sec.

name: Foreseen Circumstances
description: Guardian Spirit lasts an additional 2 sec.

name: Twinsight
description: 3 additional Penance bolts are fired at an enemy within 40 yards when healing an ally with Penance, or fired at an ally within 40 yards when damaging an enemy with Penance.

name: Assured Safety
description:
Casting Prayer of Mending applies Power Word: Shield to your target.

 Power Word: Shield
Shields an ally for 15 sec, absorbing 1,784 damage.

name: Earthquaker
description: Shockwave also knocks enemies into the air and its cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.

name: Veteran Vitality
description: When your health is brought below 35%, you gain a Second Wind, healing you for 12% of your max health over 2 sec.\n\nThis effect cannot occur more than once every 60 sec.

name: Arterial Bleed
description: Colossal Might increases the damage of your Rend and Deep Wounds by 3% per stack.

name: Unseen Blade
description:
Backstab and Shadowstrike now also strike with an Unseen Blade dealing 97 damage. Targets struck are Fazed for 10 sec.

Fazed enemies take 5% more damage from you and cannot parry your attacks.

This effect may occur once every 20 sec.

name: Melt Armor
description: Deep Breath causes enemies to take 20% increased damage from Bombardments and Essence abilities for 12 sec.\n\nThe duration of this effect is extended when Deep Breath is cast multiple times.

name: Hardened Scales
description: Obsidian Scales reduces damage taken by an additional 10%.

name: Menacing Presence
description: Knocking enemies up or backwards reduces their damage done to you by 15% for 8 sec.

name: Wingleader
description: Bombardments reduce the cooldown of Deep Breath by 0.5 sec for each target struck, up to 1.5 sec.

name: Extended Battle
description: Essence abilities extend Bombardments by 1 sec.

name: Diverted Power
description: Bombardments have a chance to generate Essence Burst.

name: Onslaught
description: Entering combat grants a charge of Burnout, causing your next Living Flame to cast instantly.

name: Unrelenting Siege
description: For each second you are in combat, Azure Strike, Living Flame, and Disintegrate deal 1% increased damage, up to 15%.

name: Smoke
description: You take 5% reduced damage from Fazed targets.

name: Mirrors
description: Feint reduces damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by an additional 10%

name: Nimble Flyer
description: While Hovering, damage taken from area of effect attacks is reduced by 10%.

name: Slipstream
description: Deep Breath resets a charge of Hover.

name: Devious Distractions
description: Secret Technique applies Fazed to any targets struck.

name: Surprising Strikes
description: Attacks that generate combo points deal 50% increased critical strike damage to Fazed targets.

name: Disorienting Strikes
description: Secret Technique has 10% reduced cooldown and allows your next 2 strikes of Unseen Blade to ignore its cooldown.

name: Flawless Form
description: Unseen Blade and Secret Technique increase the damage of your finishing moves by 4% for 12 sec. Max 5 stacks.

name: Thousand Cuts
description: Slice and Dice grants 10% additional attack speed and gives your auto-attacks a chance to refresh your opportunity to strike with Unseen Blade.

name: Flickerstrike
description: Taking damage from an area-of-effect attack while Feint is active or dodging while Evasion is active refreshes your opportunity to strike with Unseen Blade.\n\nThis effect may only occur once every 5 sec.

name: Nimble Flurry
description: Your auto-attacks, Unseen Blade, and Coup de Grace also strike up to 7 nearby enemies for 50% of normal damage while Flawless Form is active.

name: Exterminate
description: After Reaper's Mark explodes, your next 2 Obliterates or Frostscythes cost 1 Rune and summon 2 scythes to strike your enemies.\n\nThe first scythe strikes your target for 186 Shadowfrost damage and the second scythe strikes all enemies around your target for 75 Shadowfrost damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: No Scruples
description: Finishing moves have 12% increased chance to critically strike Fazed targets.

name: So Tricky
description: Tricks of the Trade's threat redirect duration is increased to 1 hour.

name: Don't Be Suspicious
description: Blind and Shroud of Concealment have 10% reduced cooldown.\n\nPick Pocket and Sap have 10 yd increased range.

name: Coup de Grace
description: After 4 strikes with Unseen Blade, your next Eviscerate will be performed as a Coup de Grace, functioning as if it had consumed 5 additional combo points, and granting you 5 stacks of Flawless Form.

name: Cloud Cover
description: Activating Shadow Blades creates a cloud of smoke for 6 sec, allowing attacks from within the cloud to apply Fazed, stacking up to 2 additional times.\n\nEffect persists for 6 sec after leaving the cloud.

name: Ravage
description:
Your auto-attacks have a chance to make your next Ferocious Bite become Ravage.

Ravage
Finishing move that slashes through your target in a wide arc, dealing Physical damage per combo point to your target and consuming up to 25 additional Energy to increase that damage by up to 100%. Hits all other enemies in front of you for reduced damage per combo point spent. 

1 point: 13 damage, 6 in an arc
2 points: 27 damage, 12 in an arc
3 points: 40 damage, 17 in an arc
4 points: 53 damage, 23 in an arc
5 points: 63 damage, 30 in an arc

name: Fount of Strength
description: Your maximum Energy and Rage are increased by 20.\n\nFrenzied Regeneration also increases your maximum health by 10%.

name: Wildshape Mastery
description:
Ironfur and Frenzied Regeneration persist in Cat Form.

When transforming from Bear to Cat Form, you retain 80% of your Bear Form armor and health for 6 sec.

For 6 sec after entering Bear Form, you heal for 10% of damage taken over 8 sec.

name: Empowered Shapeshifting
description:
Frenzied Regeneration can be cast in Cat Form for 40 Energy.

Bear Form reduces magic damage you take by 6%.

Shred and Swipe damage increased by 10%. Mangle damage increased by 25%.

name: Wildpower Surge
description: Mangle grants Feline Potential. When you have 6 stacks, the next time you transform into Cat Form, gain 5 combo points and your next Ferocious Bite or Rip deals 50% increased damage for its full duration.

name: Might of the Black Dragonflight
description: Black spells deal 20% increased damage.

name: Dreadful Wound
description: Ravage also inflicts a Bleed that causes 35 damage over 6 sec and saps its victims' strength, reducing damage they deal to you by 15%.\n\nDreadful Wound is not affected by Circle of Life and Death.

name: Ruthless Aggression
description: Ravage increases your auto-attack speed by 35% for 6 sec.

name: Killing Strikes
description: Ravage increases your Agility by 8% and the armor granted by Ironfur by 20% for 8 sec.\n\nYour first Mangle after entering combat makes your next Maul become Ravage.

name: Aggravate Wounds
description: Every attack with an Energy cost that you cast extends the duration of your Dreadful Wounds by 0.6 sec, up to 8 additional sec.

name: Claw Rampage
description: During Berserk, Shred, and Swipe have a 20% chance to make your next Ferocious Bite become Ravage.

name: Bestial Strength
description: Maul and Raze damage increased by 10%.

name: Pack's Endurance
description: Stampeding Roar's duration is increased by 25%.

name: Strike for the Heart
description: Mangle damage increased by 10% and its critical strike chance is increased by 10%.

name: Tear Down the Mighty
description: The cooldown of Sundering Roar is reduced by 15 sec.

name: Wither Away
description: Frost Fever deals its damage 100% faster, and the second scythe of Exterminate applies Frost Fever.

name: Art of the Glaive
description:
Consuming 20 Soul Fragments or casting Sigil of Spite converts your next Throw Glaive into Reaver's Glaive.

 Reaver's Glaive: 
Throw a glaive enhanced with the essence of consumed souls at your target, dealing 134 Physical damage and ricocheting to 2 additional enemies.
 
Begins a well-practiced pattern of glaivework, enhancing your next Shear and Soul Cleave.

The enhanced ability you cast first deals 10% increased damage, and the second deals 20% increased damage.

name: Incisive Blade
description: Soul Cleave deals 10% increased damage.

name: Keen Engagement
description: Reaver's Glaive generates 20 Fury.

name: Warblade's Hunger
description: Consuming a Soul Fragment causes your next Shear to deal 21 additional Physical damage.

name: Reaver's Mark
description: When enhanced by Reaver's Glaive, Shear applies Reaver's Mark, which causes the target to take 7% increased damage for 20 sec. Max 2 stacks.\n\nApplies 1 additional stack of Reaver's Mark If cast after Soul Cleave.

name: Aldrachi Tactics
description: The second enhanced ability in a pattern shatters an additional Soul Fragment.

name: Thrill of the Fight
description: After consuming both enhancements, gain Thrill of the Fight, increasing the damage of your next Reaver's Glaive by 30% and increasing Haste by 8% for 30 sec.

name: Xuen's Guidance
description: Teachings of the Monastery has a 15% chance to refund a charge when consumed. \n\nThe damage of Tiger Palm is increased by 10%.

name: Army Unto Oneself
description: Felblade surrounds you with a Blade Ward, reducing damage taken by 10% for 5 sec.

name: Fury of the Aldrachi
description: When enhanced by Reaver's Glaive, Soul Cleave casts 3 additional glaive slashes to nearby targets. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.\n\nIf cast after Shear, cast 6 slashes instead.

name: Restore Balance
description: $?c2[Healing increased by $322118s8% while Chi-Ji, the Red Crane or Yu'lon, the Jade Serpent is active.]?c3[Damage increased by $123904s4% while Xuen, the White Tiger is active.][]

name: Malevolence
description: Dark magic erupts from you and corrupts your soul for 20 sec, causing enemies suffering from your Wither to take 4,808 Shadowflame damage and increase its stack count by 6.\n\nWhile corrupted your Haste is increased by 8% and spending Soul Shards on damaging spells grants 1 additional stack of Wither.

name: Incorruptible Spirit
description: Each Soul Fragment you consume shields you for an additional 15% of the amount healed.

name: Temple Training
description: $?c2[The healing of Enveloping Mist, Vivify, and Sheilun's Gift is increased by $s1%.]?c3[Fists of Fury and Spinning Crane Kick deal $s2% more damage.][]

name: Niuzao's Protection
description: Fortifying Brew grants you an absorb shield for 25% of your maximum health.

name: Wounded Quarry
description: Expose weaknesses in the target of your Reaver's Mark, causing your Physical damage to any enemy to also deal 30% of the damage dealt to your marked target as Chaos, and sometimes shatter a Soul Fragment.

name: Celestial Conduit
description: The August Celestials empower you, causing you to radiate 387 Nature damage onto enemies and 20,555 healing onto up to 5 injured allies within 15 yds over 3.6 sec, reduced beyond 5 targets.\n\nYou may move while channeling, but casting other healing or damaging spells cancels this effect.

name: Elune's Grace
description: Using Wild Charge while in Bear Form or Moonkin Form incurs a 3 sec shorter cooldown.

name: Jade Sanctuary
description: You heal for 10% of your maximum health instantly when you activate Celestial Conduit and receive 15% less damage for its duration. \n\nThis effect lingers for an additional 8 sec after Celestial Conduit ends.

name: Courage of the White Tiger
description: Xuen claws your target for 118 Physical damage, healing a nearby ally for 100% of the damage done.\n\nInvoking a celestial guarantees your next cast activates this effect.

name: Strength of the Black Ox
description: $?c2[After Xuen assists you, your next Enveloping Mist's cast time is reduced by $443112s1% and causes Niuzao to grant an absorb shield to $443113s3 nearby allies for $443113s1.]?c3[After Xuen assists you, your next Blackout Kick refunds $s3 stacks of Teachings of the Monastery and causes Niuzao to stomp at your target's location, dealing $443127s1 damage to nearby enemies, reduced beyond $s2 targets.][]

name: Lifespark
description: Reversion healing has a chance to cause your next Living Flame to cast instantly and deal 50% increased healing or damage. Stacks up to 2 charges.

name: Titan's Gift
description: Essence Burst increases the effectiveness of your next Essence ability by 35%.

name: Heart of the Jade Serpent
description: upon Yu'lon to increase the cooldown recovery rate of  by 75% for .

name: Elemental Reverb
description: Lava Burst gains an additional charge and deals 10% increased damage.

name: Ancient Fellowship
description: Ancestors have a 20% chance to call another Ancestor for 8 sec when they depart.

name: Spiritwalker's Momentum
description: Using spells with a cast time increases the duration of Spiritwalker's Grace and Spiritwalker's Aegis by 1 sec, up to a maximum of 4 sec.

name: Earthen Communion
description: Earth Shield has an additional 3 charges and heals you for 25% more.

name: Natural Harmony
description: Reduces the cooldown of Nature's Guardian by 15 sec and causes it to heal for an additional 10% of your maximum health.

name: Heed My Call
description: Ancestors last an additional 4 sec.

name: Routine Communication
description: Riptide has a 15% chance to call an Ancestor to your side for 8 sec.

name: Final Calling
description:
When an Ancestor departs, they cast Hydrobubble on a nearby injured ally.

 Hydrobubble
Surrounds your target in a protective water bubble for 15 sec.

The shield absorbs the next 1,795 incoming damage, but the absorb amount decays fully over its duration.

name: Maelstrom Supremacy
description: Increases the healing done by Healing Wave, Downpour, and Chain Heal by 25%.

name: Primordial Capacity
description: Increases your maximum mana by 10%.\n\nTidal Waves can now stack up to 3 times.

name: Latent Wisdom
description: Your Ancestors' spells are 25% more powerful.

name: Call of the Ancestors
description: Unleash Life calls an Ancestor to your side for 12 sec.\n\nWhenever you cast a healing or damaging spell, the Ancestor will cast a similar spell.

name: Offering from Beyond
description: When an Ancestor is called, they reduce the cooldown of Riptide by 2 sec.

name: Ancestral Swiftness
description: Your next healing or damaging spell is instant, costs no mana, and deals 10% increased damage and healing.\n\nIf you know Nature's Swiftness, it is replaced by Ancestral Swiftness and causes Ancestral Swiftness to call an Ancestor to your side for 8 sec.

name: Swift and Painful
description: If no enemies are struck by Soul Rupture, you gain 10% Strength for 8 sec.\n\nWave of Souls is 100% more effective on the main target of your Reaper's Mark.

name: Chi-Ji's Swiftness
description: Your movement speed is increased by 75% during Celestial Conduit and by 15% for 3 sec after being assisted by any Celestial.

name: Inner Compass
description:
You switch between alignments every 8 sec, increasing a corresponding secondary stat by 2%.

Crane Stance:
Haste

Tiger Stance:
Critical Strike

Ox Stance:
Versatility

Serpent Stance: 
Mastery

name: Unity Within
description: Celestial Conduit can be recast once during its duration to call upon all of the August Celestials to assist you at 200% effectiveness.\n\nUnity Within is automatically cast when Celestial Conduit ends if not used before expiration.

name: Yu'lon's Knowledge
description: Rising Sun Kick damage increased by 15%.

name: Splintering Sorcery
description:
Casting Arcane Blast or Arcane Pulse conjures an Arcane Splinter.

Arcane Splinter:
Conjure raw Arcane magic into a sharp projectile that deals 219 Arcane damage.

name: Splinterstorm
description: Casting Arcane Surge generates 8 Arcane Splinters.\n\nDuring Arcane Surge, your chance to conjure an additional Arcane Splinter is increased to 100%.

name: Rider's Champion
description:
Spending Runes has a chance to call forth the aid of a Horsemen for 10 sec.

Mograine
Casts Death and Decay at his location that follows his position and extends the duration of your diseases by 1.0 sec whenever it deals damage.

Whitemane
Casts Undeath on your target dealing 2 Shadowfrost damage per stack every 3 sec, for 24 sec. Each time Undeath deals damage it gains a stack. Cannot be refreshed.

Trollbane
Casts Chains of Ice on your target slowing their movement speed by 40% and increasing the damage they take from you by 5% for 8 sec.

Nazgrim
While Nazgrim is active you gain Apocalyptic Conquest, increasing your Strength by 5%.

name: On a Paler Horse
description: While outdoors you are able to mount your Acherus Deathcharger in combat.

name: Death Charge
description: Call upon your Death Charger to break free of movement impairment effects.\n\nFor 10 sec, while upon your Death Charger your movement speed is increased by 100%, you cannot be slowed below 100% of normal speed, and you are immune to forced movement effects and knockbacks.

name: Enkindle
description: Essence abilities are enhanced with Flame, dealing 20% of healing or damage done as Fire over 8 sec.

name: Burning Adrenaline
description: Fire Breath reaches its maximum empower level 20% faster.

name: Whitemane's Famine
description: When Scourge Strike damages an enemy affected by Undeath it gains 1 stack and infects another nearby enemy.

name: Hungering Thirst
description: The damage of your diseases and Death Coil are increased by 5%.

name: Apocalypse Now
description: Army of the Dead and Frostwyrm's Fury call upon all 4 Horsemen to aid you for 20 sec.

name: Mograine's Might
description: Your damage is increased by 5% and you gain  while inside Mograine's Death and Decay.

name: Nazgrim's Conquest
description: If an enemy dies while Nazgrim is active, the strength of Apocalyptic Conquest is increased by 3%.\n\nAdditionally, each Rune you spend increase its value by 1%.

name: Fury of the Horsemen
description: Every 50 Runic Power you spend extends the duration of the Horsemen's aid in combat by 1 sec, up to 5 sec.

name: A Feast of Souls
description: While you have 2 or more Horsemen aiding you, your  increased damage.

name: Horsemen's Aid
description: While at your aid, the Horsemen will occasionally cast Anti-Magic Shell on you and themselves at 80% effectiveness.\n\nYou may only benefit from this effect every 45 sec.

name: Pact of the Apocalypse
description: When you take damage, 5% of the damage is redirected to each active horsemen.

name: Consume Flame
description: Disintegrate damage consumes 1.0 sec of Fire Breath from enemies it damages, detonating it for 150% of the amount consumed.\n\nPyre damage consumes 4 sec of Fire Breath from enemies it damages, detonating it for 115% of the amount consumed.

name: Trollbane's Icy Fury
description: Scourge Strike shatters Trollbane's Chains of Ice when hit, dealing 36 Shadowfrost damage to nearby enemies, and slowing them by 40% for 4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Mawsworn Menace
description: Scourge Strike deals 15% increased damage and the cooldown of your Death and Decay is reduced by 5 sec.

name: Splintering Orbs
description: Enemies damaged by your Arcane Orb conjure 2 Arcane Splinters, up to 4.\n\nArcane Orb damage is increased by 10%.

name: Lifecinders
description: Obsidian Scales also applies to your target or 1 nearby injured ally at 50% value.

name: Controlled Instincts
description: 40% of the direct damage dealt by an Arcane Splinter is also dealt to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

name: Shifting Shards
description: Gaining Clearcasting conjures 2 Arcane Splinters.

name: Force of Will
description: Casting Arcane Barrage conjures an Arcane Splinter for every 5 Arcane Salvo stacks consumed.

name: Slippery Slinging
description: You have 40% increased movement speed during Alter Time.

name: Look Again
description: While in combat, Blink summons a Mirror Image at your previous location.

name: Slayer's Dominance
description: Your attacks against your primary target have a 15% chance to overwhelm their defenses and trigger a Slayer's Strike, dealing 298 Physical damage and granting you a stack of Executioner, increasing your Execute damage by 3% for 12 sec. Multiple stacks of Executioner may overlap.

name: Imminent Demise
description:
Every 3 Slayer's Strikes you gain Sudden Death.

Using Sudden Death accelerates your next Bladestorm, striking 1 additional time (max 3). Bladestorm's total duration is unchanged.

Sudden Death has a 100% chance to trigger Reap the Storm at 100% effectiveness.

name: Death Drive
description: You heal for 15% of damage dealt by Sudden Death.

name: Show No Mercy
description: Executioner also increases your Execute critical strike chance and critical strike damage by 3% per stack.

name: Overwhelming Blades
description: Each strike of Bladestorm applies Overwhelmed to all enemies affected, increasing damage you deal to them by 1% for 20 sec, max 5 stacks.

name: Fierce Followthrough
description: Mortal Strike critical strikes increase the damage of your next Mortal Strike by 20%.

name: Opportunist
description: When Overpower has its cooldown reset by Tactician, your next Overpower deals 10% additional damage and 10% additional critical damage. Stacking up to 2 times.

name: Reap the Storm
description: When Cleave hits 3 or more targets you have a 20% chance to unleash a flurry of steel, striking all nearby enemies for 272 Physical damage and applying Overwhelmed. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Relentless Pursuit
description: Charge increases your movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.\n\nCharge removes all movement impairing effects, this effect cannot occur more than once every 30 sec.

name: Vicious Agility
description: Heroic Leap reduces the cooldown of Charge by 5 sec and Charge reduces the cooldown of Heroic Leap by 2 sec.

name: Culling Cyclone
description: Each strike of Bladestorm deals an additional 20% damage evenly split across all targets.

name: Slayer's Malice
description: Overpower and Execute damage increased by 15%.

name: Unrelenting Onslaught
description:
Using Sudden Death causes you to both reduce the cooldown of Bladestorm by 5 sec and apply 1 stack of Overwhelmed to your primary target per stack of Executioner you have.

You can use Pummel and Storm Bolt while Bladestorming.

Bladestorm damage increased by 20%.

name: Phantasmal Image
description: Your Mirror Image summons 1 extra clone.

name: Reactive Barrier
description: Your Prismatic Barrier can absorb up to 25% more damage based on your missing Health.\n\nMax effectiveness when under 25% health.

name: Conduit of Flame
description: Critical strike chance against targets above 50% health increased by 15%.

name: Expanded Lungs
description: Fire Breath's damage over time is increased by 30%. Dream Breath's heal over time is increased by 30%.

name: Trailblazer
description: Hover and Deep Breath travel 40% faster, and Hover travels 40% further.

name: Evasive Action
description: Vengeful Retreat can be cast a second time within 3 sec.

name: Unhindered Assault
description: Vengeful Retreat resets the cooldown of Felblade.

name: Archmage's Wrath
description: Arcane Surge damage increased by 30%.\n\nYour chance to gain Clearcasting is increased by 3%.

name: Spellfrost Teachings
description: Direct damage from Arcane Splinters reduces the cooldown of Arcane Orb by 0.25 sec.

name: Surging Totem
description: Summons a totem at the target location that creates a Tremor immediately and every 5.4 sec for 42 Flamestrike damage. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets. Lasts 25 sec.

name: Preemptive Strike
description: Throw Glaive deals 7 Physical damage to enemies near its initial target.

name: Whirling Elements
description:
Elemental motes orbit around your Surging Totem. Your abilities consume the motes for enhanced effects. 

Water: Your next Healing Wave also heals an ally inside of your Healing Rain at 50% effectiveness.

Air: The cast time of your next healing spell is reduced by 40%.

Earth: Your next Chain Heal applies Earthliving at 150% effectiveness to all targets hit.

name: Totemic Rebound
description: Chain Heal now jumps to a nearby totem within 20 yards once it reaches its last target, causing the totem to cast Chain Heal on an injured ally within 30 yards for 837. Jumps to 2 nearby targets within 20 yards.

name: Oversized Totems
description: Increases the size and radius of your totems by 15%, and the health of your totems by 30%.

name: Swift Recall
description: Successfully removing a harmful effect with Tremor Totem or Poison Cleansing Totem, or controlling an enemy with Capacitor Totem or Earthgrab Totem reduces the cooldown of the totem used by 5 sec.\n\nCannot occur more than once every 20 sec per totem.

name: Imbuement Mastery
description: Increases the duration of your Earthliving effect by 3 sec.

name: Amplification Core
description: While Surging Totem is active, your damage and healing done is increased by 3%.

name: Oversurge
description: Surging Totem deals 50% more damage while Ascendance or Healing Tide Totem is active.

name: Wind Barrier
description: If you have a totem active, your totem grants you a shield absorbing 1,833 damage for 30 sec every 30 sec.

name: Pulse Capacitor
description: Increases the healing done by Surging Totem by 25%.

name: Supportive Imbuements
description:
Learn a new weapon imbue, Tidecaller's Guard.

 Tidecaller's Guard
Imbue your shield with the element of Water for 1 hour. Your healing done is increased by 2.0% and the duration of your Healing Stream Totem is increased by 3.0 sec.

name: Lively Totems
description: When you summon a Healing Tide Totem, Healing Stream Totem, or Spirit Link Totem you cast a free instant Chain Heal at 100% effectiveness.

name: Splitstream
description: Your Healing Stream Totems heals an additional ally at 30% effectiveness.\n\nHealing Tide Totem healing increased by 25%.

name: Totemic Coordination
description: Chain Heals from Lively Totem and Totemic Rebound are 25% more effective.
