description: Bulletstorm now increases your critical strike damage by 2%. Additionally, Bulletstorm now stacks 5 more times.

name: Ursol's Warding
description: Gain magical damage reduction equal to 10% of your damage reduction from armor.

name: Lasting Words
description:
Holy Word: Serenity applies 12 sec of Renew to its target.

Holy Word: Sanctify applies 6 sec of Renew to allies it heals.

 Renew
Fill the target with faith in the light, healing for 1,223 over 12 sec.

name: Light in the Darkness
description: Increases the healing done by Holy Word: Serenity and Holy Word: Sanctify by 30%.\n\nIncreases the radius of Holy Word: Sanctify by 30%.

name: Emperor's Favor
description: Sheilun's Gift's healing is increased by 20% and its cast time is reduced by 100%, but it now only heals a single ally.

name: Howl of the Pack Leader
description:
While in combat, every 30 sec your next Kill Command summons the aid of a Beast.

 Wyvern
A Wyvern descends from the skies, letting out a battle cry that increases the damage of you and your pets by 10% for 12 sec.

 Boar
A Boar charges through your target 1 time, dealing 504 damage to nearby enemies and an additional 420 physical damage to its primary target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

 Bear
A Bear leaps into the fray, rending the flesh of your enemies, dealing 156 damage over 10 sec to up to 8 nearby enemies.

name: Dire Summons
description: Kill Command reduces the cooldown of Howl of the Pack Leader by 1.0 sec.\n\nCobra Shot reduces the cooldown of Howl of the Pack Leader by 1.0 sec.

name: Better Together
description: Damage dealt by your pets is increased by 2%.\n\nBarbed Shot damage increased by 10%.

name: Pack Mentality
description: Howl of the Pack Leader increases the damage of your Kill Command by 50%.\n\nSummoning a Beast reduces the cooldown of Barbed Shot by 4.0 sec.

name: Divine Procession
description: Smite extends the duration of an active Atonement by 2.0 sec.

name: Evangelism
description: Immediately Power Word: Radiance your target at 150% effectiveness, and causes your next 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance to be instant cast with 40% reduced mana cost.

name: Ursine Fury
description: When your Bear is summoned, it is joined by 2 Dire Beasts.

name: Sharpened Claws
description: The damage of your Bear's Rend Flesh is increased by 15%.

name: Fury of the Wyvern
description: Your pet's attacks increase your Wyvern's damage bonus by 1%, up to 10%.\n\nCasting Kill Command extends the duration of your Wyvern by 0.5 sec, up to 5 additional sec.

name: Encroaching Shadows
description: Shadow Word: Pain Spreads to a nearby enemy when you cast Penance on the target.

name: Hogstrider
description: When your Boar deals damage, the damage of your next Cobra Shot is increased by 200%.\n\nEach additional enemy damaged by your Boar causes Cobra Shot to strike 1 additional target, up to 4.

name: No Mercy
description: Your Bleed effects deal 10% increased damage.

name: Shell Cover
description: Survival of the Fittest now summons a Turtle to aid you, further increasing its damage reduction effect by 10%.

name: Slicked Shoes
description: When Disengage removes a movement impairing effect, its cooldown is reduced by 4 sec.

name: Horsehair Tether
description: When an enemy is stunned by Binding Shot, it is dragged to Binding Shot's center.

name: Stampede!
description: Casting Bestial Wrath grants Howl of the Pack Leader and causes your next Kill Command to rouse the nearby wildlife into a Stampede, charging your target and dealing 468 Physical damage over 7 sec.

name: Eagle's Accuracy
description: Aimed Shot deals 5% increased damage.\n\nRapid Fire deals 10% increased damage.

name: Double Tap
description: Casting Trueshot or Volley grants Double Tap, causing your next Aimed Shot to fire again at 80% power, or your next Rapid Fire to fire 80% additional shots during its channel.

name: No Scope
description: Rapid Fire grants Precise Shots.

name: Shrapnel Shot
description: Casting Explosive Shot has a 100% chance to grant Lock and Load.

name: Windrunner Quiver
description: Consuming Precise Shots has a 30% to grant Precise Shots.\n\nThe damage bonus of Precise Shots is increased by an additional 15%.

name: Consume
description:
Drain the essence from your target, dealing 744 Cosmic damage.

Castable while moving.

Generates 8 Fury.

name: Void Ray
description:
Requires 100 Fury
Unleash a beam of concentrated void energy, dealing 75 Cosmic damage and consuming 5 Fury every 0.1 sec.

Effect ends after 2.7 sec or upon reaching 0 Fury.

name: Intimidation
description: Your Spotting Eagle descends from the skies, stunning your target for 5 sec.\n\nThis ability does not require line of sight when used against players.

name: Cunning
description:
Your Spotting Eagle gains the Cunning specialization, granting you Master's Call and Pathfinding.

 Master's Call
Your pet removes all root and movement impairing effects from itself and a friendly target, and grants immunity to all such effects for 4 sec.

 Pathfinding
Your movement speed is increased by 8%.

name: Tenacious
description:
Your Spotting Eagle gains the Tenacity specialization, granting you Endurance Training and Air Superiority.

 Endurance Training
You gain 5% increased maximum health.

 Air Superiority
Your Spotting Eagle alerts you to oncoming danger, reducing all damage you take by 3%

name: Grievous Wounds
description: Rake, Rip, and Thrash damage increased by 10%.

name: Circle of the Wild
description: Physical damage dealt by your abilities increased by 5%.

name: Circle of the Heavens
description: Magical damage dealt by your spells increased by 5%.

name: Aessina's Renewal
description: When a hit deals more than 12% of your maximum health, instantly heal for 10% of your health.\n\nThis effect cannot occur more than once every 30 seconds.

name: Unerring Vision
description: Trueshot now increases your critical strike chance by an additional 10% and increases your critical strike damage by an additional 20%.

name: Solitary Companion
description: Your pet damage is increased by 35% and your pet is 10% larger.

name: Symbiotic Relationship
description: Form a bond with an ally. Your self-healing also heals your bonded ally for 10% of the amount healed. Your healing to your bonded ally also heals you for 8% of the amount healed.

name: Luminescence
description: Lightbearer's healing transfer is increased by up to 150% based on your current health. Lower health heals allies for more.

name: Shining Revelation
description: The light reveals all enemies in stealth or invisible to you while under the effects of Divine Shield. This effect lingers for 20 sec after Divine Shield fades.

name: Perfectly-Honed Instincts
description: Well-Honed Instincts can trigger up to once every 90 sec.

name: Demonfire Infusion
description: Periodic damage from Immolate has a 4% chance to fire a Demonfire bolt at 100% increased effectiveness.\n\nIncinerate has a 25% chance to fire a Demonfire bolt at 100% increased effectiveness.

name: Roll the Bones
description:
Roll the dice of fate, providing a combat enhancement of random power for 30 sec.

1 set or better: Add 20% increased chance to gain Opportunity.

2 sets or better: Add increased combo point generation.

3 sets or better: Add 30% bonus to Restless Blades' effect.

Jackpot: Add 10% increased critical strike chance.

name: Divinity
description: Your healing is increased by 10% while Apotheosis is active.\n\nCasting Apotheosis causes your next 3 Prayer of Healing casts to be instant and heal for 25% more.

name: Eternal Sanctity
description: Increases the duration of Apotheosis by 12 sec.

name: Dispersing Light
description: 5% of healing done with Flash Heal is replicated to 4 injured allies within 40 yards.

name: Holy Celerity
description: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Words by 15 sec.

name: Predator's Thirst
description: Consume damage increased by 15%.\n\nConsume generates a Soul Fragment.

name: Freezing Winds
description: Shattering enemies inside your Blizzard increases Shatter's area damage by 15%.

name: Thorns
description: Casting Barkskin sprouts thorns on you for 12 sec. When victim to melee attacks, thorns deals 433 Nature damage back to the attacker.\n\nAttackers also have their movement speed reduced by 50% for 4 sec.

name: Storm Conduit
description: Casting Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning reduces the cooldown of Astral Shift, Gust of Wind, Wind Shear, and Nature Totems by 1.0 sec.\n\nInterrupt duration reduced by 65% on Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning casts.

name: Sniper's Advantage
description: Trueshot and Volley increase the range of all shots by 30% for their duration.

name: Slicing Winds
description: Envelop yourself in razor-sharp winds, then lunge forward dealing 156 Nature damage to enemies in your path. Damage reduced beyond 5 enemies.\n\nHold to increase lunge distance.

name: Forest Guardian
description: Wrath, Starfire, Cyclone, and Combo-Point generating abilities extend the duration of your active heal over time effects by 1.0 sec on up to 3 allies.\n\nStarsurge and Combo-Point spending abilities increase the rate of your heal over time spells by 20% for 4 sec.

name: Dire Cleave
description: When summoned, Dire Beasts gain Beast Cleave at 100% effectiveness for 8.0 sec.

name: Therazane's Resilience
description: Earth Shield no longer loses charges and is 115% effective.

name: Lifetreading
description: Efflorescence healing increased by 25%, and it now automatically grows beneath your Lifebloom target's feet.

name: Primordial Storm
description:
Sundering transforms into a single use Primordial Storm for 15 sec after it is cast.

Primordial Storm
Devastate nearby enemies with a Primordial Storm dealing 42 Flamestrike, 41 Froststrike, 41 Stormstrike damage, and unleashing a Lightning Bolt or a Chain Lightning at 150% effectiveness. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

Consumes Maelstrom Weapon for increased damage.

name: Dark Archangel
description: Casting Evangelism increases your damage, and the damage of all allies with your Atonement by 10% for 12 sec.

name: Fulminous Roar
description: Fire Breath deals its damage 20% more often.

name: Death's Cold Embrace
description: Pillar of Frost grants you Remorseless Winter and increases its damage by 400% and its radius by 150%, but your movement speed is heavily reduced for its duration.\n\nPillar of Frost's cooldown is increased by 15 sec.

name: Bloodstones
description: Your Healthstones are replaced with Bloodstones which increase their user's haste by 20% for 12 sec instead of healing.

name: Preemptive Maneuver
description: Feint decreases your damage taken by an additional 40% while stunned and its energy cost is reduced by 30%.

name: Aspect of the Fox
description: Aimed Shot may be cast while moving during Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Cheetah's delayed effect is increased by 4 sec.

name: Sharpen Blade
description: Colossus Smash causes your next Mortal Strike to deal 15% increased damage and reduce healing taken by 50% for 4 sec.

name: Spotter's Mark
description:
Replaces Call Pet
Gain the aid of a Spotting Eagle. 

Damaging an enemy with an ability empowered by Precise Shots has a 30% chance to cause your Spotting Eagle to rapidly descend from the skies and mark your primary target.

 Spotter's Mark
Your next Aimed Shot deals 20% increased damage to this target.

name: Azure Celerity
description: Disintegrate deals damage 25% more often, but deals 10% less damage.

name: Screaming Brutality
description: Blade Dance automatically triggers Throw Glaive on your primary target for 100% damage and each slash has a 50% chance to Throw Glaive an enemy for 35% damage.

name: Overpowered Barrier
description:
Your barriers absorb 100% more damage and have an additional effect, but last 4 sec.

 Prismatic Barrier
If the barrier is fully absorbed, your next Blink or Shimmer within 15 sec grants Invisibility and immunity to damage for 3 sec. The damage reduction is lost if Invisibility ends.

name: Collapsing Star
description:
While in Void Metamorphosis, every 30 Soul Fragments harvested grants access to Collapsing Star.

 Collapsing Star
Channel an immense amount of void energy into a single, cataclysmic blast, dealing 2,121 Cosmic damage to your target and 1,610 Cosmic damage to all nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

While casting Collapsing Star, your Fury drain is significantly reduced.

name: Glacial Spike!
description:
While in combat, Frost crystallizes around you, generating an Icicle every ${$t1}.1 sec. Upon generating $s2 Icicles, $?s431044[Frostfire Bolt][Frostbolt] upgrades to Glacial Spike for its next cast.

$@spellicon199786 $@spellname199786
Conjures a massive spike of ice that impales your target, dealing $228600s1 damage and slowing the target's movement speed by $205708s1% for $205708d.

$?a1280780[|CFFffffffShatters $1280780s1 $lstack:stacks; of Freezing.|R][|CFFffffffApplies $1246769s3 $lstack:stacks; of Freezing.|R]

name: Guile
description: The cast range of Voidblade, Consume Magic, and Disrupt are increased by 20 yds.

name: Unbreakable Bond
description: Regain access to Call Pet.\n\nWhile outdoors, your pet deals 15% increased damage and takes 15% reduced damage.

name: Intuition
description: Upon reaching maximum stacks of Arcane Salvo, your next Arcane Barrage deals 25% increased damage.

name: Waste Not
description: Damage from Void Ray has a 200% increased chance to generate a Soul Fragment.

name: Reap
description: Cut a hole in the fabric of reality, sending a concentrated bolt of cosmic matter towards your target, dealing 2,558 Cosmic damage.\n\nReap gathers up to 4 nearby souls.

name: Eradicate
description:
Fully channeling Void Ray upgrades your Reap to Eradicate.

 Eradicate
Slam your Scythe to the ground, dealing 2,558 Cosmic damage to your primary target and 2,558 to all other enemies within a 25 yd cone in front of you. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Eradicate gathers up to 4 nearby souls.

name: Grove Guardians
description: Casting Swiftmend or Wild Growth summons a Treant that casts Nourish on that target or a nearby ally periodically, healing for 234. Lasts 8 sec.

name: Tentacle Slam
description:
Summons a massive shadowy appendage to slam the ground, dealing 260 Shadow damage in front of you and 8 yds around your target.

Applies Vampiric Touch to up to 6 enemies, prioritizing ones without Vampiric Touch.

Generates 6 Insanity.

name: Shattered Souls
description:
Damaging an enemy has a 4% chance to shatter a lesser soul fragment from them.

 Soul Fragment:
A fragment of your enemy's soul. Walking into the soul or casting Reap will collect it, granting you 4 Fury and healing you for 1% of your maximum health.

name: Impending Apocalypse
description: Each Collapsing Star you cast increases the damage of your next Collapsing Star by 30%.

name: Berserker Roar
description: Berserker Shout also reduces the duration of the next crowd control effect within 5 sec by 50% on group members within 12 yds.

name: Subservient Shadows
description: Summoned minions last 20% longer and deal an additional 15% damage.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Killing Streak
description: Obliterate and Frostscythe consume all Killing Machines to deal 25% increased critical strike damage and grant 1.5% Haste for 8 sec for each stack consumed.\n\nMultiple applications may overlap.

name: Howling Blades
description: Rime empowered Howling Blast unleashes 2 icy blades at its target that deal 8 Frost damage and have 15% chance to grant Killing Machine.

name: Icy Onslaught
description: Frost Strike and Glacial Advance now cause your next Frost Strike and Glacial Advance to deal 15% increased damage and cost 5 more Runic Power. \n\nThis effect stacks until the next Runic Empowerment.

name: Northwinds
description: Howling Blast now hits an additional target with maximum effectiveness. \n\nRime increases Howling Blast damage done by an additional 75%.

name: Frostreaper
description: Obliterate deals 10% increased damage and has a chance to tether the souls of its target and a nearby enemy to yours.\n\nFrost Strike severs the tethers, dealing 72 Shadowfrost damage to both foes.

name: Mindbender
description:
Casting Voidform summons a Mindbender for 10 sec.

 Mindbender
Summons a shadowy fiend to attack your target.

Generates 1 Insanity each time the Mindbender attacks.

name: Ancient Madness
description: Casting Shadow Word: Madness increases the duration of Voidform by 3.0 sec.\n\nEach time this occurs during Voidform, its effectiveness is reduced by 25%.

name: Pillars of Light
description:
Beacon of Faith:
Allies with Beacon of Light or Beacon of Faith are healed for 125 every 3 sec.

 Beacon of Virtue:
Beacon of Virtue instantly heals allies for 1,484.

name: Wildspeaker
description: Dire Beasts will now obey your Kill Command, dealing its damage at 30% effectiveness.\n\nBestial Wrath now sends your Dire Beasts into a rage, increasing their damage dealt by 10% for 15 sec. Dire Beasts summoned during a Bestial Wrath will benefit at a reduced duration.

name: Lycara's Inspiration
description:
You gain a bonus while in each form inspired by the breadth of your Druidic knowledge:

No Form: 4% Magic Damage
Cat Form: 4% Stamina
Bear Form: 5% Movement Speed
Moonkin Form: 3% Area damage taken reduction

name: Unmatched Precision
description: The damage bonus of Precise Shots is increased by an additional 10%.

name: Solar Eclipse
description:
Enter a Solar Eclipse, empowering Wrath for $48517d.

Casting Starfire changes this to Lunar Eclipse.

$@spellicon48517 $@spellname48517
Nature spells deal $48517s1% additional damage and Wrath damage is increased by $48517s3%.

name: Price of Progress
description: You sacrifice 1% of your health every 1 sec and in exchange you cannot be slowed below 90% of normal speed, and you are immune to forced movement effects and knockbacks. Lasts until canceled.

name: Dark Transformation
description: Corrupt and evolve your Ghoul into a Monstrosity, greatly empowering its abilities for 15 sec.\n\nDeath Coil and Epidemic extends the duration of this effect by 1.0 sec.

name: Void Nova
description: Unleash an eruption of void energy, dealing 106 Cosmic damage and stunning your target and all nearby enemies for 2 sec.

name: Desecrate
description: Death and Decay deals its damage 100% faster.

name: Armor Specialization
description: Armor increased by 6%.

name: Power Through Adversity
description: Second Wind reduces damage taken by 10% to 40%, with larger attacks being reduced by more.\n\nWhile Shield Wall is active, healing reductions do not apply to you.

name: Shift
description: Shift through the void, reappearing at your targeted destination.

name: Hunker Down
description: Damage you take from area of effect attacks is reduced by 2%. Spell Reflection reduces magic damage taken by an additional 10%.

name: Spellbreaker
description: You have a 8% chance to disrupt magic damage dealt to you, reducing the damage it deals by 50%.

name: Unyielding Stance
description: Defensive Stance reduces damage taken by an additional 4%.

name: Heavy Handed
description: Execute hits up to 2 additional targets for 70% damage.

name: Lay In Wait
description: Sigil of Misery has 2 charges and now lays in wait for up to 90 sec at your selected location until an enemy approaches.

name: Whirling Blade
description: Your attacks have a chance to target a nearby enemy with Ravager for 4 sec.

name: Shadow Tap
description: Mind Blast deals 150% increased damage, but costs 40% more mana.

name: Umbral Reach
description: Bleak Powder now applies Black Arrow's periodic effect to all enemies it damages.\n\nIf Bleak Powder damages 2 or more enemies, gain Beast Cleave if talented.

name: Feast of Souls
description: Soul Fragments grant 1% increased damage for 6 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.

name: Tempo Charged
description: Bronze healing and absorption increased by 15%.

name: Moment of Craving
description: After fully channeling Void Ray, the cooldown of Reap is reset and your next Reap will collect up to 6 additional Soul Fragments.

name: Frostbound Will
description: Consuming Rime reduces the cooldown of Empower Rune Weapon by 6 sec.

name: Soulshaper
description: Each Soul Fragment gathered by Reap increases its damage by 8%.

name: Grave Mastery
description: Critical strike damage of your minions is increased by 15%

name: Hungering Slash
description:
After dealing damage with The Hunt or Voidblade, Voidblade is replaced with Hungering Slash for 6 sec.

 Hungering Slash
Violently slash your scythe around you, dealing 940 Cosmic damage to nearby enemies and generating 10 Fury. Shatters up to 2 Soul Fragments from nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

Hungering Slash grants a temporary charge of Vengeful Retreat and causes your next Vengeful Retreat within 6 sec to deal an additional 570 Cosmic damage.

name: Second Helping
description: Reap gains an additional charge.

name: Unshakable
description: Your empower spells are 10% more effective. While charging a healing empower spell, you cannot be knocked back.

name: Eclipse
description:
You may draw the sun and moon into alignment for 15 sec, empowering either your Nature or Arcane spells. Casting Wrath or Starfire changes what mode of Eclipse will be entered, and the two modes of Eclipse share a button and 32 sec cooldown.

 Eclipse (Solar)
Nature spells deal 15% additional damage and Wrath damage is increased by 40%.

 Eclipse (Lunar)
Arcane spells deal 15% additional damage and Starfire damage is increased by 40%.

name: Celestial Fire
description: Moonfire, Sunfire, and Shooting Stars damage increased by 8%.

name: Sculpt the Stars
description: The cooldowns of Lunar Eclipse and Solar Eclipse are reduced by 2 sec.

name: Master Summoner
description: Increases Mastery by 3% and reduces the cast time of your Summon Demonic Tyrant and Summon Felguard by 0.5 sec.

name: Devourer's Bite
description: Damage from Voidblade and the Hunt increases the damage your target takes from you by 12% for 10 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.

name: Voidglare Boon
description: After fully channeling Void Ray, gain 10 Fury.

name: Focused Ray
description: Void Ray deals 80% more damage when damaging 3 targets.

name: Star Fragments
description: Collapsing Star now generates 3 Soul Fragments.

name: Total Eclipse
description: Entering any Eclipse has a 10% chance to grant the benefits of both Lunar and Solar Eclipse.

name: Meteor Storm
description: Starfall deals its damage 100% faster.

name: Elune's Challenge
description: When you exit Eclipse with less than 40 Astral Power, Wrath and Starfire's cast times are reduced by 20% for 15 sec or until you enter an Eclipse.

name: Death's Torment
description: Shadow Word: Death deals damage 2 additional times at 15% effectiveness.

name: Dark Thoughts
description: Increases the chance for Shadowy Insight to occur by 25%. When consuming Shadowy Insight, Mind Blast generates 1 additional Insanity.

name: Madness Weaving
description: The damage bonus from your Mastery: Shadow Weaving gains 50% additional benefit from Shadow Word: Madness.

name: Improved Eclipse
description: Lunar Eclipse and Solar Eclipse have one additional charge.

name: Meteorites
description: Every time Starfall drops a wave of stars, a meteorite also falls on up to 2 targets in its range, each dealing 86 Astral damage.

name: Celestial Infusion
description: A strong herbal brew that coalesces purified chi escaping your body into a celestial guard, absorbing 30% of incoming damage, up to 794 total.

name: Niuzao's Resolve
description: Healing Spheres now heal over 10 sec, and their healing is increased by up to 80% based on your missing health.

name: Zen State
description: The effectiveness of your Stagger is increased by up to 15%, based on your missing health.

name: Nullifying Shroud
description: Verdant Embrace wreathes you in arcane energy, preventing the next full loss of control effect against you. Lasts 3 sec.

name: Empyrean Legacy
description: Judgment critical strikes empower your next Word of Glory to automatically activate Light of Dawn at 30% effectiveness.

name: Arcane Pulse
description:
A pulse of Arcane magic erupts from underneath your target, dealing 370 Arcane damage to all enemies within 2 yds. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Each Arcane Charge increases damage by 84%, radius by 2 yds, and mana cost by 100%.

Generates 1 Arcane Charge.

name: Call of the Righteous
description: Avenging Wrath's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec, but its duration is reduced by 5.0 sec.\n\nAvenging Crusader's cooldown is reduced by 30.0 sec, but its duration is reduced by 3.0 sec.

name: Ringing of the Heavens
description: Activating Aura Mastery also casts a Divine Toll at 100% effectiveness.

name: Clawing Shadows
description: Shadows guide your strikes, increasing the damage of your Scourge Strike by 25%, and causing it to grant you Clawing Shadows up to 4 times.\n\nFor each stack of Clawing Shadows, your Scourge Strike chains to an additional enemy. Each subsequent chain deals 20% reduced damage.

name: Dream Simulacrum
description: Verdant Embrace healing is increased by 30%. In addition, it no longer causes you to leap to your target, instead sending forth a Dream Simulacrum.

name: Wings of Liberty
description: Verdant Embrace gains an additional charge.

name: Outnumber
description:
Each Lesser Ghoul increases the damage of your permanent Ghoul by 10%, and Dark Transformation additionally empowers the Claw attacks of your Lesser Ghouls to Sweeping Claws.

Sweeping Claws
Rakes an enemy with deformed claws, dealing 24 Shadow damage to the target and 16 Shadow damage to nearby enemies.

name: Seraphic Barrier
description: Word of Glory and Light of Dawn now convert 15% of their healing into an absorb shield instead.

name: Glistening Radiance
description: While at maximum health, targets with Beacon of Light generate an absorb shield equal to 1% of their health every 3 sec, up to a maximum of 5%.

name: Unholy Devotion
description: Putrefy causes your permanent Ghoul to go on an unholy frenzy, increasing its attack speed and energy regeneration by 25% for 12 sec.\n\nMultiple applications may overlap.

name: Soul Immolation
description: Light your soul aflame, healing yourself for 24% of your maximum health, generating 30 Fury and shattering 3 Soul Fragments over 5 sec.

name: Blessing of Dusk
description: Damage taken reduced by up to 10%, increasing as your health decreases.

name: Vengeful Wrath
description: Hammer of Wrath deals up to 50% additional damage based on its target's health. Lower health targets receive more damage.

name: Hand of Divinity
description: Activating Avenging Wrath calls upon the Light to empower you, causing your next 2 Holy Lights to be instant cast and cost 50% less mana.

name: Twin Echoes
description: Casting Emerald Blossom causes your next Echo to cast on an additional ally within 25 yards at 100% effectiveness. Stacks up to 2 charges.

name: Summon Gargoyle
description: Army of the Dead now summons a Gargoyle into the battlefield to bombard your enemies for 25 sec.\n\nThe Gargoyle gains 1% increased damage for every 1 Runic Power you spend and always critically strikes.

name: Forbidden Knowledge
description:
Army of the Dead siphons the power of the fallen, transforming Death Coil and Epidemic into Necrotic Coil and Graveyard for 30 sec.

Necrotic Coil
Unleash a vortex of necrotic energy and bone, dealing 77 Shadowstrike damage up to 3 foes and 24 Shadow damage to all pierced enemies.

Graveyard
The dead erupt beneath all foes with Virulent Plague, dealing 33 Shadow damage and 13 Shadow damage to enemies nearby.

name: Midnight
description: Collapsing Star always critically strikes.

name: Emptiness
description: Every soul consumed in Void Metamorphosis grants 0.25% haste, up to 25%.

name: Calamitous
description: Your damaging critical strikes deal 240% damage instead of the usual 200%.

name: Scourging
description: Scourge Strike now causes your Plagues to erupt at 50% effectiveness.\n\nClawing Shadows can now stack 1 additional times.

name: Raise Abomination
description: Army of the Dead now raises an Abomination for 30 sec to attack enemies while emitting a disease cloud, dealing 12 Plague damage to nearby enemies every 2 sec.

name: Descending Darkness
description: Increases Tentacle Slam damage by 300%.

name: Inner Flame
description: Casting Dream Flight or Stasis increases your healing over time by 60% and causes Living Flame and Reversion to have a 100% increased chance to grant Essence Burst. Lasts 15 sec.

name: Sweet Release
description: Your chance to shatter a Soul Fragment from enemies you damage is increased by 2%.

name: Phantom Menace
description: Increases the critical strike chance of Shadowy Apparitions by 10% and their critical strike damage by 40%.

name: Instilled Doubt
description: Increases the critical strike chance of Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain by 8% and their critical strike damage by 20%.

name: Jade Infusion
description: Thunder Focus Tea summons a Jade Serpent Statue at your location. When you channel Soothing Mist, the statue will also begin to channel Soothing Mist on your target, healing for 2,128 over 7.1 sec.

name: Voidrage
description: Your Mastery is increased by 2%.

name: Horrific Visions
description:
You create Horrific Visions when casting harmful spells on enemies.

At $s1 stacks of Horrific Visions, your target sees a nightmare, dealing $1243105s1 Shadow damage and granting you ${$1243113o1/100} Insanity over $1243113s2 sec.

At $s2 stacks, your target witnesses a vision of N'Zoth, dealing $1243106s1 Shadow damage and granting you ${$1243114o1/100} Insanity over $1243114s2 sec.

name: Way of the Serpent
description: Vivify healing increased by 15% and Renewing Mist's healing is increased by 30%.

name: Diffuse Magic
description: Activating Fortifying Brew transfers all currently active harmful magical effects on you back to their original caster if possible.

name: Aether Attunement
description: Arcane Missiles now damages 2 additional targets at 50% effectiveness.

name: Healing Spheres
description: Your healing has a chance to coalesces a Healing Sphere out of the mists at your target's location after 1.5 sec. If allies walk through it, they consume the sphere, healing themselves for 1,667 and dispelling all harmful periodic magic effects.\n\nMaximum of 3 Healing Spheres can be active by the Monk at any given time.

name: Orb Mastery
description: Casting Arcane Orb while you have Clearcasting causes you to fire 2 additional Arcane Orbs at 100% effectiveness.\n\nCasting Arcane Orb now consumes Clearcasting.

name: Aegwynn's Technique
description: Casting Touch of the Magi grants Clearcasting.

description: Your plagues deal up to 30% increased damage based on the target's missing health.

name: Nether Plating
description: Adorns your Darkglare with armor forged from within Antorus, increasing their armor by 10%. \n\nEye Beam now jumps to up to 4 additional targets within 10 yards and deals 10% increased damage.

name: Glacial Chill
description: Glacial Spike deals 5% increased damage and applies 2 additional stacks of Freezing.

name: Glacial Shatter
description: Glacial Spike no longer applies Freezing, and instead Shatters 5 stacks of Freezing.

name: Stance Mastery
description:
Your stances have additional effects.

 Battle Stance
Increases the critical strike damage of your abilities by 3%.

 Defensive Stance
When an attack deals 20% or more of your maximum health in damage, that damage is reduced by 15%.

name: Umbral Edge
description:
Shadow Clones deal 15% increased damage.

Cheap Shot creates a Shadow Clone to Shadowstrike the target for 50% of normal damage as Shadow.

Kidney Shot creates a Shadow Clone to Eviscerate the target for 50% of normal damage as Shadow.

name: To Hell and Back
description:
Power Siphon and Implosion summon 1 Imp Gang Boss for every 2 Wild Imps sacrificed. Wild Imps summoned this way gain Unstable Soul.

 Unstable Soul
Increases damage done by 50% and Fel Firebolt now jumps to 4 additional targets.

name: Stitchmaster
description: When a Lesser Ghoul dies, you gather the remains to heal for 2% of its maximum health.\n\nDeath Strike sacrifices all Lesser Ghouls under your command.

name: White Out
description: Ice Lance reduces the cooldown of Frozen Orb by 0.5 sec, increased by 0.1 sec for each stack of Freezing Shattered.

name: Cycle of Death
description: Putrefy reduces the cooldown of Death and Decay by 1.0 sec.\n\nDeath and Decay reduces the cooldown of Putrefy by 0.3 sec for each enemy it damages, up to 3.0 sec.

name: Mighty Inferno
description: Inferno's Blessing's damage is increased by 40%, and your effects that extend Ebon Might also extend Inferno's Blessing.

name: Chronal Dynamo
description: Living Flame's cast time is reduced by 0.2 sec, and it deals 50% increased damage or healing when it is a non-instant cast.

name: Temporal Barrier
description: Send out a ripple of temporal energy, absorbing 3,420 damage and applying Echo at 30% effectiveness on your target and up to 4 allies within 40 yds.

name: Heroic Might
description: Heroic Strike increases the damage you deal to enemies affected by your next Colossus Smash by an additional ${$1292058s1}.1%. Stacks up to $1292058u times.

name: Negotiable Contract
description: If the target of your Deathmark dies, Deathmark jumps to a nearby enemy combatant for its remaining duration.

name: Sanguine Vial
description: When you deal the killing blow to a target that yields experience or honor, the cooldown of Crimson Vial is reduced by 15 sec and your next use heals 5% of your health instantly.

name: Mark for Death
description: Move your active Deathstalker's Mark to your target.
